paragraphs.en: In Shell Bay, the summer fair was always loud. Sela, a young capybara who liked drawing, saw her small neighbor cover his ears near the music. She asked why everyone had to enjoy the fair in the same way. She wanted to make something gentle, but she did not know where to start. A small bug rested on the wall while Sela watched the fair from a quiet place. She used a camera to remember how the hall looked before their work began. The fact was simple: some neighbors went home when the music became too loud. Sela gave a friendly smile to a child who stood far from the crowd. They took a short break and shared water. A hard job felt easier when everyone could say what they needed. After the break, they went back with a clearer plan.
paragraphs.zh: 在貝殼灣，夏季節慶總是很吵。喜歡畫畫的年輕水豚塞拉，看見小鄰居在音樂旁摀住耳朵。她心想：為什麼每個人都得用同一種方式享受節日？她想做點溫柔的事，卻不知道從何開始。塞拉在安靜處看節慶時，一隻小蟲停在牆上。 她用相機記下開工前廳堂的樣子。 事實很簡單：有些鄰居一聽見太大聲的音樂就回家。 塞拉對站在人群外的孩子友善地笑了。大家短暫休息，一起喝水。當每個人都能說出自己的需要時，辛苦的工作也變得比較容易。休息後，他們帶著更清楚的計畫回去做事。

paragraphs.en: At the edge of town stood a plain hall by the sea. Inside was a white cloth left from an old dance. Sela held a small lamp behind it. Her hand made a large shape on the other side. The shape moved when she moved. Sela laughed with surprise. She pictured a future in which that child could enjoy a festival too. There was a small cup of juice on the old hall table. Daro said they should never lie about whether a test really worked. Sela placed the white cloth in the middle of the room.
paragraphs.zh: 鎮邊有一座臨海的樸素廳堂。裡面留著一塊從前跳舞時用的白布。塞拉拿著小燈站在布後，另一邊立刻出現大大的手影。她一動，影子也動。塞拉驚喜地笑了。她想像未來那個孩子也能享受節慶。 舊廳堂的桌上有一小杯果汁。 達洛說，他們絕不該謊稱測試成功。 塞拉把白布放在房間中央。

paragraphs.en: Daro, a hedgehog who made toys, came to look. He showed Sela how a piece of card could become a fish on the cloth. Uma, a patient turtle, watched them from the open door. She said that a story made of light and shade might be good for people who liked quiet things. The north window let in soft light during the morning. Uma was the first to notice the shadow growing on the cloth. The other two friends moved closer to see what Daro had made. A neighbor's pet dog rested outside instead of coming into the workroom.
paragraphs.zh: 會做玩具的刺蝟達洛走來看看。他示範如何把一片卡紙變成布上的魚影。很有耐心的烏龜烏瑪站在門口看著他們。她說，用光與影子說故事，或許很適合喜歡安靜的人。北邊的窗戶在早晨透進柔和的光。 烏瑪第一個注意到白布上的影子變大。 另外兩個朋友靠近，想看看達洛做了什麼。 鄰居的寵物狗待在外面休息，沒有進工作室。

paragraphs.en: The three friends did not plan a large party. They planned one short shadow show for neighbors who wanted a calm evening. Sela drew the hall and a little stage. Daro said he could make moving figures. Uma offered to check the time and ask what the town allowed. One family planned a picnic after the fair, away from the loud music. Sela could reach the lamp easily without stepping across Daro's tools. A red pencil lay on the table, but the friends chose plain black for the fish. One star appeared in the evening sky as they closed the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 三個朋友沒有打算辦盛大的派對。他們想為喜歡安靜夜晚的鄰居，準備一場短短的影子戲。塞拉畫下廳堂和小舞台；達洛說能製作會動的角色；烏瑪則願意確認時間與場地使用規定。有個家庭打算在節慶後去野餐，遠離吵雜的音樂。 塞拉不用跨過達洛的工具，就能輕鬆拿到燈。 桌上放著紅鉛筆，但朋友們選擇用純黑色畫魚。 他們關廳堂時，晚空出現了一顆星星。

paragraphs.en: Before they left, an older woman stopped at the open door. She had heard Sela talking about a quiet show. Would she need to join a game or sing, she asked. Sela said she could simply sit and watch. The woman smiled and asked when she could come back. Sela could not give her a date yet, so Uma offered to bring the news when the plan was ready. Then Daro put the fish flat in a box. They would use it again, but first they needed to ask about the hall. Sela looked at the white cloth one last time. This was no longer only an idea in her head. Someone was waiting to hear more.
paragraphs.zh: 離開前，一位年長婦人在開著的門邊停下。她聽到塞拉談安靜表演，便問是否得參加遊戲或唱歌。塞拉說，她可以只坐著看。婦人笑了，問什麼時候能再來。塞拉還無法給日期，烏瑪便答應，計畫確定後會通知她。接著，達洛把紙魚平放進箱。他們會再用它，但得先問清廳堂的事。塞拉最後看了一眼白布。這不再只是她腦中的點子；已有人等著聽更多消息。

questions.question: Why did Sela want a quiet show?
options: Some neighbors found the fair too loud.
She needed to repair a bridge.
questions.explanation: 有些鄰居覺得節慶太吵，因此塞拉想提供另一種活動。

questions.question: What did Sela use to make the first shadow?
options: A small lamp and white cloth.
questions.explanation: 她用小燈照向白布，做出了第一個影子。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, Uma led Sela and Daro to the town office. A goat named Oren cared for public rooms. He listened to their idea and showed them the hall rules. The hall could be used for a free event, but the friends had to leave it clean and safe. Uma said anyone could come to the town office to ask about public rooms. Oren lived in a small apartment above the office with his family. Sela wanted to ask about every rule before promising a show. The old church bell rang while the friends walked toward the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 隔天早上，烏瑪帶塞拉和達洛去鎮公所。負責公共空間的山羊歐倫聽了他們的點子，拿出廳堂規則。廳堂可以用來辦免費活動，但朋友們得保持乾淨、安全。烏瑪說，任何人都能到鎮公所詢問公共場地。 歐倫與家人住在公所樓上的小公寓。 塞拉想先問清所有規則，再承諾演出。 朋友們走向廳堂時，老教堂的鐘響了。

paragraphs.en: Oren said the town had to choose how to use the hall next month. Some people wanted it for boxes and old chairs. Others wanted a place to meet. If the shadow night worked, the town could see a new use for the room. Sela felt the weight of that chance. Oren made the rules clear so no one had to guess. Families from the country outside town sometimes visited the summer fair. Sela did not forget to thank Oren for listening to her plan. Daro said they should not guess how many people would fit in the room.
paragraphs.zh: 歐倫說，鎮上必須決定下個月如何使用廳堂。有些人想把它當作放箱子和舊椅子的地方，另一些人想要聚會空間。如果影子夜成功，大家就能看到這個房間的新用途。塞拉感受到這次機會的重要。歐倫把規定說清楚，讓大家不用猜。 住在鎮外鄉間的家庭有時會來參加夏季節慶。 塞拉沒有忘記感謝歐倫聽她說明計畫。 達洛說，他們不應猜測房間能容納多少人。

paragraphs.en: They walked through the hall with Oren. Uma counted doors and places to sit. Daro checked a low table that could hold the figures. Sela saw that a good idea still needed clear rules. The event would take place in three weeks, and every visitor had to be welcome. Here by the door, Uma found enough space for a safe path. The friends agreed that no helper should have to work late without a choice. They ate lunch under a tree while discussing their list of tasks. Sela said visitors would not have to pay to watch their play.
paragraphs.zh: 他們和歐倫一起走過廳堂。烏瑪數了門和座位的位置；達洛檢查一張能放角色的矮桌。塞拉發現，再好的點子也需要清楚的規則。活動將在三週後舉行，而且每位訪客都應受到歡迎。就在門邊，烏瑪找到足夠空間規劃安全通道。 朋友們同意，不應讓任何幫手被迫工作到很晚。 他們在樹下吃午餐，同時討論工作清單。 塞拉說，觀眾不必付錢就能看戲。

paragraphs.en: Outside, the three friends shared a small lunch. Daro wanted to start making figures at once. Uma asked them to write down the tasks first. Sela agreed. The three friends could each take a different kind of work, and no one needed to carry the whole plan alone. Uma used a blue pen to mark each task with its owner's name. Daro tested a small piece of card before making a larger figure. They passed a quiet pond on the walk back to the hall. A local reporter asked Sela what made a shadow show different from a concert.
paragraphs.zh: 到了外面，三人吃了一頓簡單的午餐。達洛想立刻動手做角色；烏瑪請大家先把工作寫下來。塞拉同意了。三個人可以分別負責不同任務，沒有人必須獨自承擔整個計畫。烏瑪用藍筆標上每項工作的負責人。 達洛先測試一小片卡紙，才製作更大的角色。 回廳堂的路上，他們經過一座安靜的池塘。 一位地方記者問塞拉，影子戲和演唱會有什麼不同。

paragraphs.en: At the hall, Uma pointed to the old sofa in the side room. It could stay only if people could still reach the door. Daro moved a box and asked her to try the path again. This was a serious part of the plan, not a small job to leave until the night of the show. Sela wrote three tasks on a clean page. The first was the story, the second was the room, and the third was asking neighbors what they needed. Oren had given Uma his office phone number. She placed it beside the room plan. They now knew whom to ask when a question was too large for the three of them.
paragraphs.zh: 回到廳堂，烏瑪指向側室的舊沙發。只有不妨礙人走到門口，它才能留下。達洛搬開一個箱子，請她再走一次。這是計畫裡必須認真處理的部分，不能留到演出當晚。塞拉在乾淨紙上列三項工作：第一是故事，第二是房間，第三是問鄰居需要什麼。歐倫給了烏瑪辦公室電話，她把號碼放在配置圖旁。現在，遇到三個朋友無法決定的問題，他們知道該問誰。

questions.question: What did Oren say about using the hall?
options: The event had to be free and safe.
The hall had to become a shop.
questions.explanation: 歐倫允許免費活動，但要求保持場地安全與乾淨。

questions.question: When was the shadow event planned?
questions.explanation: 三人約定三週後辦影子夜。

paragraphs.en: On the third day, Daro brought a paper fish to the hall. He held it close to the lamp, and its shadow grew so large that only half of it showed. When he moved it back, the fish became very small. The friends learned that the space between light and paper mattered. All the friends watched the paper fish change size in the light. Uma marked an area on the floor where the table could stand. A basketball left in the hall rolled away when Daro moved the chairs. They were ready to begin a new test with a smaller gap.
paragraphs.zh: 第三天，達洛帶來一條紙魚。他把魚靠近燈，影子就大到只看得見一半；往後移動時，魚又變得太小。朋友們學到，燈與紙之間的距離很重要。所有朋友都看著紙魚在燈光下改變大小。 烏瑪在地板標出可以放桌子的區域。 達洛搬椅子時，廳堂裡的一顆籃球滾走了。 他們準備縮小距離，開始新的測試。

paragraphs.en: Uma placed a line on the floor for the lamp and another line for the puppet table. She told the friends to test the same place each time. Sela drew a fish that could open its mouth. Daro used two sticks to make the parts move in a simple way. Sela tried to define the best size for the fish on the screen. Uma planned to email the two guests a short invitation to watch. Sela used an eraser to remove a line that confused the fish's face. Only a few people were needed for this early test.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪在地上為燈畫一條線，也替玩偶桌畫一條線。她要大家每次都在同樣的位置測試。塞拉畫了一條會張嘴的魚，達洛用兩根小棒讓部件能簡單移動。塞拉試著訂出魚在布幕上最合適的大小。 烏瑪打算寄電子郵件，邀兩位客人來看。 塞拉用橡皮擦擦掉讓魚臉看起來不清楚的線。 這次初期測試只需要少數幾人。

paragraphs.en: They called two neighbors to watch a short test. The fish moved, but the lines on its face were hard to see from the back. One neighbor could not tell where the fish was going. Sela was hurt for a moment, yet she thanked the visitor for saying what was unclear. The lamp stood on a firm table away from loose paper. Daro did not leave any sharp tools on the floor. A simpler fish with less detail looked clearer from the back. Uma did not mail an invitation because the two guests lived next door.
paragraphs.zh: 他們請兩位鄰居來看短測試。魚動了，但坐在後方的人看不清臉上的線條。有位鄰居甚至看不出魚往哪裡去。塞拉一時有些難過，但仍感謝對方說出不清楚的地方。小燈放在穩固的桌上，遠離鬆散紙張。 達洛沒有把尖銳工具留在地上。 細節比較少的簡單魚形，從後面看更清楚。 兩位客人住隔壁，所以烏瑪沒有用郵寄邀請函。

paragraphs.en: Daro made the fish larger and cut out a round eye. Uma moved the chairs until the view was better. They tried again. Now the children could follow the fish from one side to the other. Sela understood that the test was not a judgment of her worth. It was a way to learn. The test gave their old hall a modern new purpose. The friends agreed to finish before night so no one would walk home in darkness. Sela kept an orange marker for drawing the fish's moving parts. A small plant near the entrance helped visitors find the right door.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛把魚做大，並挖出圓形的眼睛。烏瑪移動椅子，直到視線更好。他們又試了一次。現在孩子們能看清魚從一端游到另一端。塞拉明白，測試不是在評判她的價值，而是學習的方法。這次測試讓舊廳堂有了現代的新用途。 朋友們同意天黑前結束，避免有人摸黑回家。 塞拉留了一支橘色筆，畫魚會動的部分。 入口旁的一株小植物，幫助訪客找到正確的門。

paragraphs.en: Sela asked the two guests to return at three p.m. the next day. A quarter of an hour would be enough for another look at the fish. One guest said the road had less traffic then, after the market carts had gone. Uma wrote down the time so nobody would need to guess. Daro put the larger fish beside the first one. From near the table, the older fish still looked lovely. From the back chairs, its face disappeared. Sela kept both rather than throwing one away. They showed why the change was needed. 'I will watch from the back next time,' she said. The guests would see the fish; she needed to see what the guests saw.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉請兩位客人隔天下午三點再來，十五分鐘就夠再看一次紙魚。一位客人說，市場推車那時已離開，路上交通較少。烏瑪記下時間，免得大家猜。達洛把較大的魚放在第一條旁。從桌旁看，舊魚依舊可愛；從後排看，臉卻消失了。塞拉留下兩條，沒有丟掉任何一條。它們能說明為何需要修改。「下次我會坐後面看，」她說。客人要看的是魚；她需要看見的，是客人眼中的樣子。

questions.question: What made the fish shadow too large?
options: The puppet was too near the lamp.
questions.explanation: 紙魚太靠近燈，影子才會變得太大。

questions.question: How did the group improve the fish?
options: They hid it in a box.
They made it larger and changed the seating.
questions.explanation: 達洛把魚做大，烏瑪也調整了座位。

paragraphs.en: Before they built more figures, Uma asked everyone to look at the hall entrance. There was a high step near the door, and one chair stood in the way. Some guests might need a wide, clear path. Sela had been thinking about the screen, not about how people would reach it. The side room had a bath, though visitors only needed its sink to wash their hands. One old chair could block the path if they left it near the door. Both Daro and Sela helped Uma measure the entrance. Uma brought a bowl of water to clean the dusty table.
paragraphs.zh: 在繼續做角色前，烏瑪請大家檢查廳堂入口。門邊有一道高階，還有椅子擋路。有些客人需要寬敞、沒有障礙的通道。塞拉原本只在想布幕，沒想到人們要怎麼進來。側室有浴缸，但訪客只需要那裡的水槽洗手。 一張舊椅子若留在門邊，就會擋住走道。 達洛和塞拉都幫烏瑪測量入口。 烏瑪帶來一碗水清理滿是灰塵的桌子。

paragraphs.en: They asked the town for a safe board that could make the step easier. Oren said an adult worker would set it in place and check it. Daro did not try to make a fast fix by himself. He moved tables and kept the floor free of loose things. Giving visitors a choice of seats made the room feel kinder. Nobody had to cross a busy work area to reach the seats. Daro drew a cute little fish on the safety sign for young readers. Morning light entered through the east door while they moved tables.
paragraphs.zh: 他們向鎮上申請一塊能讓台階較好通行的安全板。歐倫說會請成年工作人員安裝並檢查。達洛沒有自己草率修理，而是搬開桌子，清除地面上鬆散的東西。讓訪客自己選位子，使房間感覺更友善。 沒有人必須穿過忙碌的工作區才能到座位。 達洛在安全告示上畫了一條可愛小魚，給年幼讀者看。 他們搬桌子時，早晨的光從東門照進來。

paragraphs.en: Sela made two kinds of seats. Some friends liked to sit near the front, and others wanted a quiet place by the wall. Both were good choices. She placed the lamp so that its light would not shine into the eyes of people coming through the door. A green line on the floor showed where the free path began. Sela turned her head to check the lamp from the back row. Daro gave a gentle knock on the door before moving the tall shelf. They took another look at the seats before asking guests to come in.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉安排兩種座位。有些人喜歡坐前排，另一些人想靠牆安靜坐著；兩種選擇都很好。她也把燈放在不會直射入場者眼睛的位置。地板上的綠線標示出通暢走道的起點。 塞拉轉頭，從後排查看燈光。 搬動高架前，達洛輕輕敲了門。 請客人進來前，他們再次查看座位。

paragraphs.en: At the test, an older guest asked if he could leave early without being seen by everyone. Uma showed him the open side door. She said no one would ask why a visitor needed to go. Sela felt proud that the room was beginning to care for more kinds of people. A medium chair fit the small space better than the large old sofa. Mrs. Vale, an older neighbor, asked for a chair with a back. Sela said they must make the path clear before practice began. Uma said the side door was not a place to store bags. The day did not go exactly as they had hoped. Still, they had learned one useful thing. They added it to their plan, so tomorrow would begin with a little more knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 測試時，一位年長客人問能不能提早離開而不被大家看見。烏瑪帶他看側門，說不會有人追問離開的原因。塞拉很高興，這個房間開始能照顧不同需求的人。中型椅子比大舊沙發更適合小空間。 年長的鄰居維爾太太想要一張有椅背的椅子。 塞拉說，練習開始前必須清出走道。 烏瑪說，側門不是放袋子的地方。這一天並沒有完全照他們希望的方式進行。不過，他們仍學到一件有用的事。他們把它加進計畫，讓明天能從多一點的理解開始。

paragraphs.en: A taxi stopped outside while they were putting the chairs back. The older guest who stepped out wanted to see the new way into the hall. Uma walked beside her, and Daro moved out of the path with his box. The guest reached a chair without asking anyone to carry her things. That was a happy surprise for Sela. She had spent so long looking at a fish that she had forgotten how much a doorway could matter. They would pass the plan to Oren before calling the room ready. For now, Sela added the guest's question to her notes: could she find the same clear path when every chair was full?
paragraphs.zh: 他們把椅子放回去時，一輛計程車停在外面。下車的年長客人想看新的入場方式。烏瑪陪她走，達洛拿著箱子讓出通道。客人不必請誰拿東西，就走到椅子旁。這讓塞拉驚喜。她看紙魚看了太久，竟忘了門口也能如此重要。他們還得把配置圖交給歐倫，才會說房間已準備好。此刻，塞拉先記下客人的問題：如果每張椅子都坐滿，她還找得到同一條通暢的路嗎？

questions.question: Why did the friends change the hall entrance?
options: To make the room harder to find.
To provide a safer, wider path.
questions.explanation: 為了讓不同需要的訪客都能安全入場。

questions.question: What could guests do if they needed to leave early?
options: Use the side door without giving a reason.
questions.explanation: 烏瑪告訴訪客可以從側門離開，不必說明原因。

paragraphs.en: Sela wanted to make a story about a fish who thought the sea was too wide. The fish would meet other small animals and learn to ask for help. Daro liked the idea, but he said that too many scenes would take time. They decided to make three simple scenes and test each one. The small bank near the market opened before the friends started their work. A farm outside town offered old clean card boxes for their figures. Sela remembered to feed the fish at home before going to the hall. Uma wrote a letter to the town thanking it for the free room.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉想寫一條覺得大海太寬的魚的故事。魚會遇到其他小動物，學習開口求助。達洛喜歡這個點子，但他說場景太多會耗費時間。於是他們決定先做三個簡單場景，逐一測試。市場附近的小銀行在朋友們開工前就開門了。 鎮外農場提供乾淨的舊紙箱，給他們製作角色。 塞拉記得去廳堂前先餵家裡養的魚。 烏瑪寫了一封信，感謝鎮上免費提供空間。

paragraphs.en: Uma drew a long line on a large sheet. She marked the days left before the festival and the jobs for each day. She asked the group to leave a little free time. A plan that filled every minute could break at the first surprise. The others saw that she was right. Many small tasks looked easier when they were put on one clear list. The moon would rise after the quiet show, not during the first test. Daro watched a short movie about moving paper shapes in a safe way. They did not put oil near the lamp because it was not needed.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪在大紙上畫了長線，標出距離節日剩下的日子，以及每天要做的事。她請大家留一點空檔，因為把每一分鐘都排滿的計畫，可能遇到第一個意外就失效。其他人知道她說得對。許多小任務寫在清楚的清單上後，看起來容易多了。 月亮會在安靜演出後升起，而不是第一次測試期間。 達洛看了一部短片，介紹如何安全地移動紙形。 他們不把油放在燈旁，因為根本不需要。

paragraphs.en: Daro showed how the paper fish could swim behind the cloth. Sela cut another figure to stand for the shore. It took more time than they guessed. One corner tore, and the stick would not stay on the paper. They changed the shape instead of hiding the problem. Sela said they would not sell food or toys at the free show. Daro moved the puppet in a slow line so young viewers could follow it. He cut one long straight edge from the sheet of strong paper. A strange shadow appeared when the stick bent behind the cloth.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛示範紙魚如何在布幕後游動。塞拉剪出另一個角色代表岸邊。這花的時間比預計多。一個角落裂開，小棒也黏不住。他們沒有掩飾問題，而是改了形狀。塞拉說，免費表演當天不會販售食物或玩具。 達洛讓玩偶緩慢移動，好讓年幼觀眾跟上。 他從厚紙上剪出一條長長的直邊。 小棒在白布後彎曲時，出現了奇怪的影子。

paragraphs.en: At midday, a few young visitors came to see the work. They wanted a loud ending with music. Sela explained that this was meant to be a quiet show. She invited them to make soft sounds with their hands instead. They tried it and found that a gentle rhythm could still feel exciting. They tested a short string but chose a firm stick for better control. One teenager showed the group how to make a soft beat with two fingers. Sela needed time to think before changing the last scene. Sunlight came through the window and made the paper figure easy to see.
paragraphs.zh: 中午時，幾位年輕訪客來看製作。他們想要用很大聲的音樂結尾。塞拉解釋這是安靜的表演，邀請他們改用雙手發出柔和聲音。大家一試，發現輕柔節奏也能令人興奮。他們測試短繩，最後選擇較好控制的硬棒。 一位青少年示範如何用兩根手指打出輕柔節拍。 塞拉需要時間思考，才決定要不要修改最後一場。 陽光穿過窗戶，讓紙角色看得很清楚。

paragraphs.en: Uma held the box open while Daro found a place for each figure. He moved his toe away before she lowered the lid. On the wall, a yellow card still marked the scene that needed work. Sela had wanted to finish it before going home, but the fish's loose mouth could wait. Their last topic was where to put each figure so the next day's work would begin without a long search. Daro drew the box on the plan and added a small mark for the fish. Sela put her pencil down. She could see tomorrow's job, and she did not have to do it tonight. The three scenes would grow one at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪扶著箱子，達洛替每個角色找好位置。她放下箱蓋前，他先把腳趾移開。牆上的黃色卡仍標著需要修改的場景。塞拉原想回家前做完，但魚鬆動的嘴可以等。最後的話題，是每個角色該放哪裡，好讓明天不用找很久。達洛在配置圖畫出箱子，再替魚加一個小記號。塞拉放下鉛筆。她看得見明天的工作，卻不必今晚就完成。三個場景會一步一步長大。

questions.question: How many simple scenes did the team plan first?
questions.explanation: 大家先規劃三個簡單場景。

questions.question: Why did Uma leave free time on the plan?
options: She wanted everyone to be late.
The group might face unexpected problems.
questions.explanation: 烏瑪預留時間，因為製作可能出現意外與延誤。

paragraphs.en: When the friends counted their supplies, they found only enough card for a few more figures. Sela wanted to buy bright paper and more lamps. Uma asked how they would pay for them. The show was meant to be free, so they could not use money they did not have. Daro lifted his arm to show the friends a sheet of clean card. Uma said the nearby store was convenient because they could walk there together. Sela looked into a deep box but found only a few usable pieces. The small desk by the wall became the place for their supply list.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友們清點材料時，發現卡紙只夠再做幾個角色。塞拉想買亮色紙和更多燈，烏瑪卻問錢從哪裡來。表演本來就是免費的，他們不能花沒有的錢。達洛抬起手臂，向朋友展示一張乾淨卡紙。 烏瑪說附近的店很方便，大家可以一起走去。 塞拉往深箱子裡看，只找到幾片可以用的材料。 牆邊的小書桌成了放材料清單的地方。

paragraphs.en: They made a list of what they truly needed. A safe lamp, strong card, and plain cloth came first. Nice colors and new boxes could wait. Daro suggested using old clean card from his workshop. He asked the people who owned it before taking any piece. Sela asked what they could do without buying any new tools. Uma put the store receipt into an envelope to keep it clean. Daro hoped to find strong paper among the clean old boxes. A drawing of a fish reminded the group why they needed the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 他們列出真正需要的物品：安全的燈、厚卡紙和素布最優先。漂亮的顏色與新盒子可以等。達洛提議使用工作室裡乾淨的舊卡紙，而且每拿一張都先問主人是否同意。塞拉問，不買新工具還能做些什麼。 烏瑪把店家收據放進信封，以免弄髒。 達洛希望從乾淨的舊箱中找到結實紙張。 魚的圖畫提醒團隊，為何需要那些紙。

paragraphs.en: A small store offered them some cloth for less money. Its owner did not ask for her name on the show. Sela thanked her and made sure everyone knew the gift had no hidden rule. Uma wrote the value in their records. That way the group could be open about the help it received. They told a funny story as they sorted the old supplies. Uma read the hall's history to learn what the town had used it for. However, the records did not say that the hall could store every old box. The group said a neighbor may help only if the neighbor truly wants to.
paragraphs.zh: 一家小店願意便宜提供一些布。店主沒有要求把名字放進演出裡。塞拉道謝，也確認這份贈與沒有附帶條件。烏瑪把價值記在紀錄中，讓團隊能公開說明收到的協助。整理舊材料時，他們說了一個有趣的故事。 烏瑪閱讀廳堂歷史，了解鎮上以前如何使用它。 然而，紀錄並沒有說廳堂可以存放所有舊箱子。 團隊說，鄰居只有自己願意才可以幫忙。

paragraphs.en: In the evening, Daro tried the old card. Some pieces bent too easily, while others worked well. He kept only the strong ones. Sela learned that a free show did not mean careless work. They could be careful with money and still make something good for their neighbors. They wiped the mud from their shoes before carrying the card inside. The news about the free show reached the small market that afternoon. Sela watched the paper fish rise slowly on the white cloth. There was a seat by the door for anyone who needed to rest.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚，達洛測試舊卡紙。有些太容易彎，有些卻很好用。他只留下夠牢固的部分。塞拉明白，免費表演不代表可以隨便做。他們能省錢，也能為鄰居做出好作品。搬卡紙進屋前，他們先擦掉鞋上的泥。 那天下午，免費演出的消息傳到了小市場。 塞拉看著紙魚在白布上緩緩升起。 門邊設了一個座位，讓需要休息的人使用。

paragraphs.en: The shop owner watched Uma put the gift beside the paid items on her list. He was surprised that she wanted to show both. Uma said the town should know what the team had bought and what neighbors had offered. Sela asked Daro to speak if the old card broke in the next test. A gift did not have to be used if it could not do the job. The owner showed them another piece of cloth, but they did not take it before checking their money. On the walk back, Sela carried a smaller bag than she had hoped for. It was enough to start. At the door she turned the sign outward: every guest would be welcome, not only the people who could give.
paragraphs.zh: 店主看烏瑪把贈品與付費物品一併記在清單上，很驚訝她兩種都要列。烏瑪說，鎮上應知道團隊買了什麼，也知道鄰居提供什麼。塞拉請達洛在下次測試時，若舊卡紙破了就坦白說。東西雖是贈品，不適用就不必勉強用。店主拿出另一塊布，但朋友們先核對錢，沒有立刻收下。回程，塞拉的袋子比預期小，卻足夠開始工作。到門口，她把告示轉向外面：歡迎所有客人，不只歡迎有能力捐助的人。

questions.question: Why did the friends make a supply list?
options: To spend only on needed things.
questions.explanation: 為了在資源有限的情況下只購買必要物品。

questions.question: Did visitors have to donate money?
questions.explanation: 團隊決定活動免費，無須捐款或勞務。

paragraphs.en: Sela did not want to tell only her own story. She visited the homes near the west beach and asked what scenes people remembered from childhood. Some were ready to talk; others wanted to keep their memories private. Sela thanked both groups. A story was a gift, not something she could take. Sela made notes by the shore while listening to the neighbors' stories. A child brought one square of chocolate to share after the talk. The local art class had many drawings of life near the sea. Uma asked for permission to collect family stories before using them in the play.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉不想只說自己的故事。她走訪西邊海灘附近的住家，詢問人們童年記得的場景。有些人樂意分享，有些人想保留隱私。塞拉對兩種回答都表示感謝。故事是禮物，不是她可以任意取走的東西。塞拉在岸邊聽鄰居說故事時做筆記。 一個孩子帶來一小塊巧克力，想在談話後分享。 當地美術課畫了許多海邊生活的圖。 烏瑪先徵求同意，才把家族故事用進戲裡。

paragraphs.en: An older neighbor spoke about looking for small shells after school. Another remembered a mother singing while she washed clothes. A young rabbit wanted a funny scene with a fish in a hat. The friends laughed at the idea and asked if they could use it. The child gave a happy yes. Daro said a short course in puppet making might help young helpers. An older neighbor held a white flower while she spoke about her childhood. They stayed only one hour so the families could return to their work. A housewife told Sela that her work at home also held many stories. A new question came up, and nobody knew the answer at once. The friends did not hide that fact. They chose to try a small test and learn from what really happened.
paragraphs.zh: 一位年長鄰居談起放學後找小貝殼的回憶。另一人記得母親洗衣時唱歌。一隻小兔子想看戴帽子的魚出現在滑稽場景裡。朋友們聽了都笑了，並問能否採用這個點子；孩子開心答應。達洛說，簡短的玩偶製作課可能對年輕幫手有幫助。 一位年長鄰居談童年時，手裡拿著一朵白花。 他們只待一小時，讓家庭能回去做事。 一位家庭主婦告訴塞拉，家裡的工作也藏著許多故事。一個新問題出現了，沒有人立刻知道答案。朋友們沒有隱瞞這件事。他們決定先做小測試，再從實際發生的結果學習。

paragraphs.en: Back in the hall, Uma wrote every idea on a different card. She also wrote who had allowed the group to share it. Daro made a soft hat for the fish puppet. Sela looked at the cards and saw that the town had many kinds of stories, not one single story. A large book lay on Uma's table beside the notes from neighbors. Sela said she would let people say no without asking them to explain. Uma made a list of the ideas that neighbors agreed to share. The main idea was to tell a story that belonged to the group together.
paragraphs.zh: 回到廳堂，烏瑪把每個點子分別寫在卡片上，也記下誰同意分享。達洛替魚偶做了一頂柔軟帽子。塞拉看著卡片，發現小鎮有許多不同種類的故事，而非只有一個共同故事。烏瑪桌上放著一本大書，旁邊是鄰居的筆記。 塞拉說，如果人們拒絕，她不會要求解釋。 烏瑪列出鄰居同意分享的點子。 主要想法是說一個由大家共同創作的故事。

paragraphs.en: The group chose three ideas that could fit their short play. They kept the family song out because the neighbor asked them not to use it on stage. Sela told her friends that permission could change. Someone who had said yes before could still say no later, and they would listen. Daro made a note beside the idea about a fish with a hat. The funny fish became popular among the children who tested the play. A young rabbit said the fish should learn to ask for help. Sela asked whether the rabbit's story was real or an idea for a play.
paragraphs.zh: 大家選了三個適合短劇的點子。至於那首家族歌曲，鄰居不希望搬上舞台，他們便不用。塞拉告訴朋友，同意也可能改變；即使先前答應的人後來說不，他們仍會尊重。達洛在戴帽子的魚那個點子旁寫下備註。 滑稽的魚受到試看戲的孩子們喜愛。 一隻小兔子說，魚應該學會求助。 塞拉問小兔子的故事是真事，還是戲的點子。

paragraphs.en: Back at the hall, Sela looked at the empty place beside the shell card. It was for the song they would not use. She did not fill the space with another person's words. The neighbor's answer would stay no until that person chose something different. There were still three scenes to start with, and a funny fish with a new hat. Daro set the hat gently on the table while Uma read the names on the idea cards. Sela could hear the sea through the window. She had walked west looking for stories to bring home. Now she understood that listening also meant leaving some stories where they already belonged.
paragraphs.zh: 回到廳堂，塞拉看著貝殼卡旁的空位。那裡原本要放他們不會使用的歌曲。她沒有拿別人的話填滿它。除非那位鄰居自己改變想法，拒絕就仍是拒絕。他們還有三個場景可以開始，也有戴著新帽子的滑稽魚。達洛輕輕把帽子放桌上，烏瑪讀著點子卡上的姓名。海聲從窗外傳來。塞拉原先往西走，是想帶故事回來；如今她懂得，聆聽有時也表示，把一些故事留在它們原本所屬的地方。

questions.question: What did Sela do when someone kept a memory private?
options: She thanked the person and respected the choice.
She told everyone to guess it.
questions.explanation: 她尊重不願分享的決定。

questions.question: What new detail did a child suggest?
questions.explanation: 小兔子建議一條戴帽子的魚。

paragraphs.en: A small museum opened only twice a week near the town square. Sela, Daro, and Uma went there to learn how people had made pictures long ago. A guide showed them simple shapes cut from thin wood. The shapes looked very different from their paper fish, but the idea of light was familiar. Uma borrowed a book about old ways of making shadows on cloth. Daro thought the first room was boring until he saw the moving shapes. The guide said using a knife without care could be dangerous. A sign showed that a small model cost only one dollar to make.
paragraphs.zh: 鎮上廣場旁的小博物館每週只開兩天。塞拉、達洛與烏瑪前往了解古人如何製作圖像。導覽員展示了薄木板剪出的簡單形狀。它們看起來與紙魚很不一樣，但用光呈現影子的想法很熟悉。烏瑪借了一本介紹古代布幕影子技法的書。 達洛原本覺得第一間展室很無聊，直到看到會動的形狀。 導覽員說，不小心使用刀子可能很危險。 告示說，製作一個小模型只需一元。

paragraphs.en: The guide explained that one old scene belonged to a family. It was not free for other groups to claim as their own. Sela asked if they could learn the way the shapes moved while writing their own story. The guide smiled and said learning a method was different from taking someone's story. Each old figure had a different shape, even when the story was simple. The guide asked if anybody else wanted to try the model. Uma saved a file with the notes from their museum visit. At lunch, Daro used a fork to eat fruit beside the museum. No one worked alone. When one pair of hands became tired, another friend took a turn. Sela wanted every helper to feel that this new show was theirs, not only hers.
paragraphs.zh: 導覽員說，有一齣老戲屬於某個家族，別的團體不能拿來說是自己的。塞拉詢問，能不能學習形狀的移動方式，卻寫自己的故事。導覽員微笑回答：學習方法和拿走別人的故事是兩回事。每個舊角色都有不同的形狀，即使故事很簡單。 導覽員問，還有沒有別人想試模型。 烏瑪把博物館參訪筆記存成檔案。 午餐時，達洛在博物館旁用叉子吃水果。沒有人獨自工作。當一雙手累了，另一位朋友就接手。塞拉希望每位幫手都能覺得這場新表演屬於大家，而不是只屬於她。

paragraphs.en: Daro took careful notes. He liked the way a small wheel made a head turn. He tried a simple paper model at a table in the museum workshop. It worked, but the paper tore after three turns. He could see what was useful and what needed a stronger material. The museum hall was full of small tools and old pictures. Sela got an idea for a new way to move the fish's head. The friends learned to listen before asking questions about the old art. Daro saw his mistake when the weak paper broke during the test.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛仔細做筆記。他喜歡小輪子讓角色轉頭的方式，於是在博物館工作桌上試做一個紙模型。模型能動，但轉三次後紙就破了。他看出哪些做法有用，以及哪些地方需要更牢固的材料。博物館展廳擺滿小工具與舊照片。 塞拉想到讓魚頭移動的新方法。 朋友們學會先聽講解，再詢問古老藝術的問題。 脆弱的紙在測試中破裂時，達洛看出了自己的錯誤。

paragraphs.en: Uma found an old drawing of people sitting around a cloth screen. Some watched from chairs, and some sat on the floor. She pointed out that their own hall needed space for many kinds of bodies. The museum trip gave her ideas about how to keep the view open. The museum showed many ways people had made art before electric lights. They ate a small snack at noon before walking home. The guide showed a picture of a queen but said they could write a different story. Daro made a small wheel roll under the paper figure.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪找到一張舊畫，畫中人們圍著布幕坐下。有些坐椅子，有些坐地板。她指出，他們的廳堂也需要容納不同身體需求的空間。這趟博物館之行，讓她想到保持視線通暢的方法。博物館展示了人們在電燈出現前創作藝術的方法。 他們中午吃了小點心後才走回家。 導覽員展示女王畫像，但說他們可以自己寫不同的故事。 達洛讓小輪子在紙角色下面滾動。

paragraphs.en: On the walk home from the museum, Daro held the broken paper wheel flat between two boards. Their test had not been successful, but he could now show where the paper had torn. Sela asked whether a stronger piece would turn in the same way. They would have to try it. Uma said she would tell the guide what they learned and name the museum when they described the method. A train passed beyond the square, making the friends stop talking for a moment. When it was quiet again, Sela asked about their next fish. Uma smiled. 'You can make that story your own,' she said. 'We borrowed a way to move, not a life to put on stage.'
paragraphs.zh: 離開博物館時，達洛把破掉的紙輪夾平在兩塊板中。測試不成功，但他已能指出紙在哪裡裂開。塞拉問，換成較結實的紙是否也能同樣轉動；他們得試試。烏瑪說，會把結果告訴導覽員，介紹方法時也會說明博物館來源。一列火車從廣場遠處經過，朋友們暫停說話。安靜下來後，塞拉問起下一條魚。烏瑪微笑：「那個故事可以由你自己創作。我們借來的是移動的方法，不是把誰的人生搬上舞台。」

questions.question: What did the guide teach about an old family story?
options: The friends could claim it as theirs.
The friends should write their own story.
questions.explanation: 導覽員提醒他們尊重家族故事，只學方法而自行創作。

questions.question: What failed after three turns?
questions.explanation: 達洛的紙模型轉動三次後破裂。

paragraphs.en: The friends invited a small group to watch their first linked scenes. Sela thought a silent show would be easy for everyone. She was wrong. A visitor who could not see the thin lines well asked for someone to say what was happening. Another visitor wanted less talking. Their wishes seemed to pull in different directions. A bear visiting the hall asked where to sit for the spoken version. Sela felt brave enough to ask visitors about their different needs. A farmer who came from outside town liked the silent version best. A foreigner visiting the bay asked whether the show used many words. Sela listened to the others before she gave her answer. She had made this plan, but that did not mean every idea had to come from her. A better way could begin with any friend.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友們邀請一小群人觀看第一次連起來的幾個場景。塞拉以為無聲表演對所有人都容易，結果她錯了。一位看不清細線的訪客希望有人說明劇情，另一位則想少聽些話。兩種願望看起來互相衝突。一隻來訪的熊問，有旁白的場次該坐哪裡。 塞拉鼓起勇氣，詢問訪客不同的需求。 一位鎮外農夫最喜歡無聲版。 一位來訪海灣的外國人詢問，表演會不會用很多話。塞拉先聽完大家的想法，才說出自己的答案。雖然計畫由她提出，卻不代表每個點子都得出自她。一個更好的方法可能從任何朋友開始。

paragraphs.en: Sela felt worried. She had made the show quiet because some neighbors did not like loud music. Now she saw that quiet did not always mean clear. Daro said they could test a spoken version with gentle words. Uma suggested a separate viewing time when the same story could be watched without speech. Uma said they should keep the choice open for every guest. One quiet visitor said he sometimes felt lonely at loud town events. They did not want to lose the calm feeling of the first idea. A neighbor offered some meat for dinner, but the helpers had already eaten.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉很擔心。她因為鄰居不喜歡大聲音樂，才想做安靜的演出。現在她看見，安靜不一定表示清楚。達洛提議試做溫柔旁白版；烏瑪建議另排一個時段，讓人能不聽旁白觀看相同故事。烏瑪說，應為每位客人保留選擇。 一位安靜的訪客說，自己在吵鬧活動中有時感到孤單。 他們不想失去最初點子的平靜感。 一位鄰居拿肉來當晚餐，但幫手們已吃過了。

paragraphs.en: They asked both visitors what would help. The first wanted short lines that named each character. The second wanted to see the show without being asked questions. The friends wrote down these requests. They were not trying to make everybody the same; they were trying to give people a choice. A child brought a cup of milk and sat near the back. Sela said there was nothing wrong with wanting a quieter room. Every person could say what made watching the show easier. The photographer took a photograph only after asking the visitors.
paragraphs.zh: 他們問兩位訪客怎麼做會比較好。第一位希望有簡短句子介紹角色；第二位希望觀看時不必被問問題。朋友們把需求記下來。他們不是要把每個人變得一樣，而是想給人選擇。一個孩子帶著一杯牛奶，坐在後面。 塞拉說，想要比較安靜的房間沒有什麼不對。 每個人都可以說出怎樣觀看比較容易。 攝影師先徵求訪客同意，才拍下一張照片。

paragraphs.en: At the next test, Uma stood near the screen and quietly told the first part of the tale. Daro kept the figures large. Sela watched faces in the room, not only the moving shadows. One visitor leaned forward during the spoken part. In the next part, another enjoyed watching without a voice beside the screen. A small bell could ring once before each show, but not loudly. Sela felt sad when she learned that the first test had left someone out. A young singer offered to speak the short lines in a soft voice. Uma made sure the toilet was easy to find for all guests.
paragraphs.zh: 下一次測試時，烏瑪站在布幕旁，輕聲說明故事開頭。達洛把角色維持得夠大。塞拉觀察的不只是移動的影子，也看房間裡的表情。有聲片段中，一位訪客感興趣地前傾。接著無聲片段開始，另一位自在地觀看，不必聽布幕旁的人聲。每場戲前可以輕敲一次小鈴，但聲音不能太大。 塞拉得知第一次測試忽略了某人時，覺得難過。 一位年輕歌手願意用柔和聲音說短台詞。 烏瑪確認所有訪客都容易找到廁所。

paragraphs.en: Sela wrote two viewing times on the wall plan, then looked at the visitors still sitting near the back. Whose idea should she name beside the change? One visitor pointed to Uma; Uma pointed to the questions on Sela's page. The answer had grown from more than one voice. Sela drew a line between the two times to show that guests would not need to listen to the spoken part if they chose the quiet one. A warm room was not only a room with warm air. It was also a place where someone could say what did not work. Before she closed the hall, Sela asked the visitors whether she had understood them correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉在牆上寫下兩個觀賞時段，望向仍坐後排的客人。這項更動旁該寫誰的名字？一名訪客指烏瑪，烏瑪卻指向塞拉紙上的問題。答案來自不只一個聲音。塞拉在兩個時段間畫線，表示選安靜場的客人不必一起聽有聲場。溫暖的房間，不只是空氣溫暖，也是讓人能說出哪裡不適合自己的地方。關廳堂前，塞拉再問一次客人：她是否真的理解了他們的意思。

questions.question: Why did the group plan two ways to watch?
options: Visitors had different needs for sound.
questions.explanation: 有人需要旁白，有人喜歡安靜，因此安排兩種觀看方式。

questions.question: What did Sela learn?
options: Asking visitors is better than guessing.
No one can enjoy a quiet show.
questions.explanation: 她學到應直接詢問觀眾需求。

paragraphs.en: Daro built a small box to hold the lamp, but its switch was hard to find behind the screen. During practice he reached too far and knocked over a paper figure. Sela stopped the scene. They needed a safer way to change the light, especially while people were moving in the dark. Uma looked around the lamp table to find the hard-to-see switch. Daro tested a large button that was easy to feel with one finger. The room became dark only after the small path light was turned on. They checked the light before the evening practice began.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛做了一個小盒子放燈，但布幕後很難摸到開關。練習時，他伸手太遠，碰倒了紙角色。塞拉立刻停止。尤其在黑暗中有人移動時，他們需要更安全的開關方式。烏瑪在燈桌周圍找那個難看見的開關。 達洛測試一個用手指就容易摸到的大按鈕。 只有先打開小走道燈，房間才會變暗。 傍晚練習開始前，他們先檢查燈光。

paragraphs.en: Uma read the lamp guide and asked Oren to check the place for its wire. Oren said only the town worker could change the room's power parts. The friends decided not to touch those things. They could use a simple battery lamp on a firm table instead. A paper fish could fall from the table if it was not held in place. Sela asked if they could have a safer way to turn the light off. Daro said the new test was interesting because nobody needed to reach far. Uma put the spare lamp on the left side of the work table. Outside, the sound of the bay came through the open door. It reminded Sela why she wanted a show in this town. It was a place where different voices could meet.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪閱讀燈具說明，請歐倫檢查電線位置。歐倫說，只有鎮上的工作人員能修改房間的電力設備。朋友們決定不去碰那些東西，改用放在穩固桌上的簡單電池燈。紙魚若沒有固定好，就可能從桌上掉下來。 塞拉問，是否有更安全的方式關燈。 達洛說，新測試很有趣，因為沒有人需要伸手太遠。 烏瑪把備用燈放在工作桌左側。門外，海灣的聲音從敞開的門傳進來。這提醒塞拉為何想在這個小鎮辦演出：她希望不同的聲音能在這裡相遇。

paragraphs.en: Daro added a large button that was easy to feel. He tested it many times while standing still. Sela moved the figures without touching the lamp. Uma watched to be sure no path was blocked. The light went on and off at the right moments, and nothing fell. A small menu of light settings was taped beside the new button. Daro ate a potato snack after testing the light twenty times. A rose in a vase stood far from all the electric parts. The visiting neighbor gave Sela a smile when the path light worked.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛加裝一個容易摸到的大按鈕。他站在原地反覆測試。塞拉移動角色時不碰燈；烏瑪則確認走道沒有被擋住。光線在對的時刻亮起、熄滅，而且沒有東西倒下。一張簡單的燈光選單貼在新按鈕旁。 達洛測試二十次燈後，吃了馬鈴薯點心。 花瓶裡的玫瑰遠離所有電力設備。 走道燈正常運作時，來訪鄰居對塞拉笑了。

paragraphs.en: They asked a neighbor to watch the test from the last row. The visitor said that the shadow still showed clearly when the light changed. She also said the room felt safe because there was a small path light near the exit. The friends wrote down her words as useful advice. The sound of the little switch was soft enough for the quiet show. They could stay in the hall only until the town worker closed it. A student watched from the last row and said the fish remained clear. The lamp gave a sweet, soft light across the white cloth.
paragraphs.zh: 他們請一位鄰居從最後一排觀看測試。那位訪客說，燈光切換時仍能清楚看到影子。她還說，出口旁有微弱的走道燈，讓人覺得安全。朋友們把她的話記為有用建議。小開關的聲音很輕，適合安靜表演。 他們只能待到鎮上工作人員關廳堂為止。 一名學生從最後一排觀看，說魚影仍然清楚。 燈把柔和可愛的光投在白布上。

paragraphs.en: Daro put his hand by the new button and asked Sela to watch the fish. This time the light changed without his arm crossing the table. The old trouble had looked small until a paper figure fell. Now they could see why Sela had called a stop. Uma usually checked the doorway before the room went dark, and she asked them to leave time for that check in the play. Daro made a mark beside the light change. They did not want to worry a guest who stood up at that moment. Sela tried the move once more. The little button had not made the story more exciting. It had made room for the story to happen.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛把手放在新按鈕旁，請塞拉看魚。這次燈光切換時，他的手臂不必跨過桌面。紙角色掉下來之前，舊問題看似很小，如今大家明白塞拉為何喊停。烏瑪通常會在房間變暗前檢查門口，也請他們把這段時間排進戲裡。達洛在燈光切換旁做記號。他們不想讓此刻站起來的客人擔心。塞拉再試一次。小按鈕沒有讓故事更刺激，卻讓故事有機會好好發生。

questions.question: What problem did the first light switch cause?
options: It was hard to find behind the screen.
questions.explanation: 原來的開關在布幕後很難找到。

questions.question: What light did the friends choose?
options: A battery lamp on a firm table.
questions.explanation: 他們選擇放在穩固桌上的電池燈。

paragraphs.en: Uma invited several neighbors to try the seats during a short practice. A young bird wanted to sit near the screen, while an older goat asked for a chair with a back. Someone needed room for a walking stick. Sela saw how much care was needed before the first figure even moved. Uma brought a basket of clean cloth for people to use at the hall. Daro put his belt on a hook so it would not catch on a chair. The friends had to check the seats before anyone entered the room. Sela used a bright color to mark the safe path on her drawing.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪邀請幾位鄰居在短練習時試坐。小鳥想坐在布幕附近，年長的山羊想要有椅背的椅子，還有人需要放手杖的空間。塞拉發現，在第一個角色動起來之前，就需要很多照顧。烏瑪帶來一籃乾淨的布，供廳堂的人使用。 達洛把皮帶掛在鉤子上，避免勾到椅子。 朋友們必須在訪客進屋前檢查座位。 塞拉用亮色在圖上標出安全走道。

paragraphs.en: Daro put marks on the floor so the chairs would stay away from the clear path. He asked people to tell him when a seat felt too close. A thin line of light showed the way to the door. Uma made a drawing of the room and kept it beside the entrance. A dear older friend asked for a seat near the entrance. Sela said she would hate to make anyone feel unwelcome by accident. Uma thought about visitors' health and comfort, but did not ask for private details. The town hospital had taught workers how to keep public paths clear.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛在地上做記號，讓椅子不會擋住通道。他請大家在座位太擠時告訴他。細細的燈光標出了通往門口的路。烏瑪畫出房間配置圖，放在入口旁。一位親愛的年長朋友想坐在入口附近。 塞拉說，她不願意無意間讓任何人感到不受歡迎。 烏瑪考慮訪客的健康與舒適，卻不打聽私人細節。 鎮上的醫院曾教工作人員如何保持公共走道通暢。

paragraphs.en: One visitor said she had to take a short break every few minutes. She worried she would disturb the show. Sela told her that coming and going were both fine. The group would not stop the story to look at her. This answer made the visitor smile, and Sela felt she had done something right. Uma said that if a guest needed to stand up, they could do so. Daro told a gentle joke to help a worried child relax. A kite flew outside the window while the guests tried the chairs. Sela found a useful picture of the room in a library book.
paragraphs.zh: 一位訪客說自己每幾分鐘就需要休息一下，擔心會打擾表演。塞拉告訴她，進出都沒有關係，團隊也不會為了看她而中斷故事。那位訪客笑了，塞拉覺得自己做對了一件事。烏瑪說，如果客人需要站起來，就可以站起來。 達洛說了個溫和的笑話，幫擔心的孩子放鬆。 客人試坐椅子時，窗外有風箏飛過。 塞拉在圖書館的書中找到一張有用的室內配置圖。

paragraphs.en: The friends practiced their greeting. It was short: visitors could choose a seat, ask for help, or leave when needed. There was no test to pass and no right way to enjoy the show. Uma said this greeting mattered just as much as the words in the play. The friends often changed a chair after hearing a new request. Uma put the seating picture beside the hall entrance for everyone to see. A young ball player needed more space to rest a sore leg. Uma said they could send a simple guide to guests before the show.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友們練習簡短的歡迎詞：訪客可以選位子、要求協助，也能在需要時離開。來看表演不必通過測試，也沒有唯一正確的欣賞方式。烏瑪說，這段歡迎詞與戲裡的台詞同樣重要。朋友們聽到新需求後，常會調整一張椅子。 烏瑪把座位配置圖放在入口旁，讓大家看得到。 一名年輕球員需要較大的空間，讓痠痛的腿休息。 烏瑪說，他們可以在演出前寄給客人簡單指南。

paragraphs.en: Those two chairs by the back door had looked useful when the room was empty. With someone sitting in each, the way out became too narrow. Daro moved them while Uma watched from the doorway. Sela asked the guests to try leaving and returning during the fish's short journey. She kept moving the figure rather than turning toward every person who stood up. From the last row, the fish still showed clearly against the white cloth. One visitor came back smiling. She had taken the break she needed and had not become part of the show. Sela put the two extra chairs in the side room. More chairs did not always mean a better welcome.
paragraphs.zh: 空房間裡，後門旁那兩張椅子看似很有用；有人坐上去，出口卻變窄了。達洛搬椅子，烏瑪在門口看。塞拉請客人試著在魚的短旅途中離開、再回來。她繼續移動角色，不因有人起身就轉頭注視。從最後一排看，白布上的魚仍很清楚。一位客人微笑著回座。她得到需要的休息，也沒有變成表演的一部分。塞拉把兩張多餘椅子收進側室。椅子更多，不一定就表示歡迎做得更好。

questions.question: Why did the friends mark the floor?
options: To keep a clear path between seats.
questions.explanation: 地面標記可讓座位不擋住走道。

questions.question: What could visitors do during the show?
options: Leave only after asking the mayor.
questions.explanation: 訪客有需要時可以自由休息。

paragraphs.en: The town asked Sela for a simple program. She wrote the story title but did not know whose name should appear under it. She had drawn the first fish, yet many neighbors had helped. Daro made the figures, Uma planned the seats, and others shared ideas that they had allowed the group to use. A young actor offered to read a short line for the spoken show. The group met in the afternoon to decide how to name the helpers. A small band asked if its members could help with soft music. Sela wanted to celebrate the work of everyone behind the cloth.
paragraphs.zh: 鎮上請塞拉交一份簡單的節目單。她寫下故事名稱，卻不知道下面該放誰的名字。第一條魚雖然是她畫的，但許多鄰居都幫了忙。達洛做角色、烏瑪安排座位，其他人也同意團隊使用自己的點子。一位年輕演員願意替有聲版念一句短台詞。 團隊下午開會，決定如何列出幫手姓名。 一個小樂團詢問，團員能否幫忙演奏柔和音樂。 塞拉想慶祝每位在白布後工作的人的努力。

paragraphs.en: At a group meeting, Sela asked everyone what kind of credit they wanted. Some liked to see their names in print. Others preferred a quiet thank-you without a name. The friends did not make a single rule for all. Uma wrote down each person's answer. Daro drew a tiny shell in the corner of the program cover. Sela said no kind idea should die only because its maker was shy. Uma put on her glasses to read the small names in the draft. Sela wrote, 'I want every helper to choose how to be thanked.' Uma looked at the time and called everyone together.
paragraphs.zh: 在團隊會議上，塞拉問每個人希望如何被致謝。有些人喜歡名字印出來，另一些人想要沒有署名的低調感謝。朋友們沒有用一條規則套在所有人身上。烏瑪記下每個人的回答。達洛在節目單封面角落畫了小貝殼。 塞拉說，一個好點子不該只因創作者害羞就消失。 烏瑪戴上眼鏡，閱讀草稿上細小的姓名。 塞拉寫道：「我希望每位幫手都能選擇如何被感謝。」

paragraphs.en: Daro made a picture for the front of the program. It showed a fish looking toward a wide sea. He did not put a crown on the fish, because the story was about asking for help, not being the most important animal in the bay. Sela liked the simple drawing. The key to fair credit was asking, not making a guess. Daro checked the last name on the list before printing. A visitor from local media asked whether the show had a ticket price. Sela said more people had helped than she first remembered.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛替節目單封面畫了一張圖：魚望向寬廣的大海。他沒有替魚戴王冠，因為故事說的是求助，而非成為海灣最重要的動物。塞拉喜歡這張簡單的畫。公平署名的關鍵在於詢問，而不是猜測。 達洛在印製前確認清單上的最後一個名字。 地方媒體的一位來訪者詢問，演出是否有票價。 塞拉說，提供協助的人比她最初記得的還多。

paragraphs.en: Some neighbors asked where they could buy tickets. Uma explained that the show was free. They would give out paper tickets only to help count seats and keep the room from becoming too full. Nobody would earn money from the people watching. The hall belonged to the town. They planned to open the hall at six o’clock before the short show. Some helpers wanted their names on the page, or a quiet thank-you without a name. A small package of paper tickets arrived from the town office. Daro asked if children could play with a spare figure after the show. The old hall was changing one step at a time. Its walls were still plain, and its floor still showed years of use. Yet the friends could now picture children and parents enjoying a show there.
paragraphs.zh: 有鄰居問去哪裡買票。烏瑪解釋，表演免費，紙票只用來計算座位，避免房間過度擁擠。大家不會從觀眾身上賺錢，因為廳堂屬於整個小鎮。他們計畫在短劇前，六點鐘開放廳堂。 有些幫手希望名字登在紙上，或者只要不具名的低調道謝。 鎮公所送來一小包紙票。 達洛問孩子們能不能在演後玩備用角色。老廳堂正一步一步改變。牆面仍很樸素，地板也留著多年的痕跡。但朋友們已經能想像孩子和家長在這裡欣賞表演的樣子。

paragraphs.en: They were tired when the last program came out, so Uma asked everyone to read only one small part at a time. She checked the paper from the supermarket. Daro checked the picture. Sela read the names against the answers the helpers had given. A missing name could still be added before the next printing; a private name could still be taken out. Near the bottom, Uma wrote that each ticket cost nothing. Rich and poor neighbors would enter by the same door. Sela put the program beside the first fish drawing. The fish had begun with her pencil. The longer page beside it showed how far it had traveled through other people's hands.
paragraphs.zh: 最後一份節目單印好時，大家都累了。烏瑪請每人一次只讀一小部分：她檢查從超市買來的紙，達洛看圖，塞拉則把姓名與幫手先前的回答逐一比對。漏掉的名字仍能在下次印製前補上；希望保密的名字也能撤下。頁面底部，烏瑪寫明票券免費。富裕和貧窮的鄰居，會從同一扇門進來。塞拉把節目單放在第一張紙魚圖旁。魚從她的鉛筆開始，旁邊那張較長的紙，卻顯示它經過多少雙別人的手。

questions.question: Why did the group give out paper tickets?
options: To count seats for a free show.
questions.explanation: 紙票只用來控制座位數量，演出仍免費。

questions.question: How did they decide whose names to print?
questions.explanation: 團隊逐一詢問幫手是否願意具名。

paragraphs.en: The afternoon sun came through a wide window and made the shadow fish hard to see. Daro thought the lamp was broken. Uma looked carefully and found that the bright window, not the lamp, was the problem. They decided to test the show at the same time of day as the festival. The fish shadow looked beautiful when the bright window was covered. Daro used a brown card to make the shell keeper stand out. A school camp visited the bay and asked to see a short practice. The friends placed a chair beside the door for the visiting teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 下午陽光從寬窗照進來，讓魚影變得難看清。達洛以為燈壞了。烏瑪仔細觀察後發現，問題不是燈，而是明亮的窗戶。他們決定在與節日相同的時段測試表演。遮住明亮窗戶後，魚影看起來很美。 達洛用棕色卡紙讓貝殼守護者更顯眼。 一個學校營隊來到海灣，想看簡短練習。 朋友們在門旁放了一張椅子給來訪老師。

paragraphs.en: Sela wanted to close every window at once. Uma asked them to think about air and comfort, too. They used a light cloth to stop the direct sun while keeping the room comfortable. Daro checked that no cloth touched the lamp or blocked the way to the door. A duck outside called softly as the afternoon light changed. Sela did not want to fight the sunlight with a stronger lamp. The window was high, so an adult worker helped hang the shade. Uma offered honey tea to the helpers during a short rest.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉想立刻把所有窗戶關上。烏瑪提醒他們也要考慮空氣和舒適度。他們用淺色布擋住直射陽光，同時保持房間舒服。達洛確認布沒有碰到燈，也沒有擋住門口。下午光線變化時，外面有隻鴨子輕輕叫著。 塞拉不想用更強的燈來對抗陽光。 窗戶很高，因此由成年工作人員幫忙掛遮光布。 短暫休息時，烏瑪給幫手們喝蜂蜜茶。

paragraphs.en: A group of children came after school. They watched the new shadow and could see the fish's eye clearly. One child said the fish looked worried. Sela smiled, because that was exactly how the fish should feel at the start of the story. The picture was finally telling the feeling she wanted. The fish moved toward its home, but it had not reached the shore yet. Sela asked Daro to lead the next light test while she watched from the back. Every member of the group had a part in making the screen easy to see. After the rain began, Uma checked the mat near the entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 放學後，一群孩子來看新影子。他們能清楚看到魚的眼睛。有個孩子說魚看起來很擔心。塞拉笑了，因為故事一開始，她就希望魚有這樣的心情。畫面終於能表達她想說的感受。魚朝家移動，但還沒到岸邊。 塞拉請達洛帶領下一次燈光測試，自己到後排觀看。 每位團員都參與了讓布幕清楚可見的工作。 雨開始下後，烏瑪檢查了入口附近的地墊。

paragraphs.en: Then a short rain began outside. Sela thought about what might happen if visitors arrived with wet shoes. Uma put a clean mat by the door and made a place for coats. The rain did not stop their test. It simply gave them another small job to prepare. One child wanted to read the fish's feelings from its simple face. A short ride home was possible for visitors who did not want to walk in rain. The old story had a soldier in it, but Sela made her own story about a fish. The stair near the side door had a firm rail for people who needed it.
paragraphs.zh: 接著外面下起一陣短雨。塞拉想到，如果觀眾穿著濕鞋進來該怎麼辦。烏瑪在門口放了乾淨地墊，也規劃放外套的位置。雨沒有停止測試，只是提醒他們多準備一件小事。一個孩子想從魚簡單的表情看懂牠的心情。 不想在雨中步行的訪客可以短程搭車回家。 舊故事裡有士兵，但塞拉創作的是自己的魚故事。 側門附近的階梯有牢固扶手，供需要的人使用。

paragraphs.en: Though the afternoon test was short, Sela wanted one more view from the back before they left. The window cloth kept the bright sun off the screen without covering the door. She could still feel air moving as the fish crossed the white space. Daro stood beside the window and asked her to call when the shadow became hard to see. Uma wrote down the time of that change. The room, the light, and the chairs had to work together; a good fish shape could not do everything by itself. At sunset, Sela took the window cloth down. They would put it up for the next test, with the same clear space around it.
paragraphs.zh: 下午測試雖短，塞拉離開前仍想從後面再看一次。窗布擋住直射布幕的陽光，沒有遮住門；魚穿過白色空間時，她仍感覺得到空氣流動。達洛站在窗旁，請她在影子難看清時出聲。烏瑪記下變化時間。房間、光和椅子得一起配合，好的魚形無法獨自完成一切。日落後，塞拉把窗布取下。下次測試再掛回去時，周圍也會保留同樣的空間。

questions.question: What made the fish shadow hard to see?
questions.explanation: 窗外的陽光太亮，影響了影子的可見度。

questions.question: What did the team add because of rain?
options: A coat area and clean mat.
questions.explanation: 為了避免濕鞋造成問題，增設地墊及外套區。

title: A Small Hurt, A Better Rule

paragraphs.en: During a fast practice, Daro turned and hit his arm on the corner of a table. The hurt was small, but everyone stopped at once. Sela felt afraid that their work was becoming too rushed. She asked Daro if he wanted to sit down and said they would not go on until he felt ready. An ant walked across the table just before the fast practice began. Daro kept his bag under a chair, far from the walking path. A bottle of clean water stood near the place for short breaks. A chicken from the nearby yard called as the friends opened the door.
paragraphs.zh: 一次快速練習時，達洛轉身撞到了桌角，手臂有點痛。雖然只是小傷，大家立刻停下來。塞拉擔心工作節奏太急，便問達洛要不要坐下休息，並說他準備好之前不會繼續。快速練習開始前，一隻螞蟻爬過桌面。 達洛把袋子放在椅子下，遠離走道。 休息區旁放著一瓶乾淨的水。 朋友們開門時，附近院子裡的雞叫了一聲。

paragraphs.en: Uma brought a clean cloth and asked the town worker to help check the sharp table corner. She did not pretend to be a doctor. Daro said he was all right after a rest, but he agreed that the table should move. They changed the space before touching the figures again. The town clerk helped them find the correct worker to check the table. Daro could either rest now or go home early, and he chose to rest. Sela asked where they should hang the new sign about walking. Uma said they needed an honest report about what had happened.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪拿來乾淨的布，請鎮上工作人員檢查桌子尖角。她沒有假裝自己是醫生。達洛休息後說已經好一些，但同意把桌子移開。大家在重新碰角色之前，先調整空間。鎮公所職員幫他們找到能檢查桌子的正確人員。 達洛可以現在休息，或提早回家，他選擇休息。 塞拉問大家，新步行告示應掛在哪裡。 烏瑪說，他們需要一份誠實的事件報告。

paragraphs.en: Sela felt unhappy because she had asked Daro to hurry. She told him she was sorry. He did not want a long speech; he wanted a safer path and enough time. The friends agreed to stop every practice after a short period and check the room before beginning again. Daro said his arm still hurt a little, so they ended the practice early. A newspaper worker visiting the town heard about the safer rehearsal plan. Uma said the police did not need to come for this small accident. The room felt more open after they moved the table away from the path.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉因為自己催達洛快一點而難過。她向他道歉。達洛不需要長篇大論，只希望有安全的走道和足夠的時間。朋友們同意每練一段就停下休息，重新開始前再次檢查場地。達洛說手臂還有點痛，因此大家提早結束練習。 來鎮上採訪的報社人員聽說了更安全的排練計畫。 烏瑪說，這場小意外不需要警察到場。 把桌子移出走道後，房間感覺更開闊。

paragraphs.en: They also made a simple sign for the hall: walk, do not run, behind the screen. The sign was easy to read and did not blame anyone. Daro helped choose where it should hang. Sela understood that a rule works better when the people using the room help make it. Several helpers checked the table corners before the next rehearsal. Daro wore comfortable shorts for moving the paper figures behind the cloth. A visiting child felt sick and rested quietly with a family member. The size of the table mattered because helpers needed room to turn.
paragraphs.zh: 他們也做了一塊簡單告示：「布幕後請走路，不要跑。」字很容易讀懂，也沒有責怪任何人。達洛幫忙決定掛的位置。塞拉明白，讓使用空間的人參與制定規則，規則才更容易被遵守。下一次排練前，幾位幫手檢查了桌角。 達洛穿著舒適短褲，在白布後操作紙角色。 一位來訪孩子覺得不舒服，和家人一起安靜休息。 桌子的尺寸很重要，因為幫手需要轉身空間。

paragraphs.en: They would try the new table places before another full run. Daro walked the short route with empty hands, then carried one figure along it. This took more time than a quick run behind the cloth, but he did not hit his arm. Uma wrote down the total time from the first light to the last shadow. It was shorter than before, because nobody had to stop and pick up a fallen thing. Sela asked Daro how his arm felt before they began again. She wanted his answer, not only a faster number on Uma's page. The next practice would use the new route. Tonight the figures stayed in their boxes while Daro went home to rest.
paragraphs.zh: 下次完整排練前，他們會先試新的桌子位置。達洛先空手走一遍短路線，再拿一個角色走。這比在白布後快跑花時間，卻不會再撞手臂。烏瑪記下第一道光到最後一道影子的總時間，反而比先前短，因為不必停下來撿東西。重新開始前，塞拉問達洛手臂感覺如何。她要的是他的回答，不只是烏瑪紙上更快的數字。下次練習會用新路線。今晚，角色留在箱內，達洛先回家休息。

questions.question: What made the group stop practice?
options: Daro hit his arm on a table.
questions.explanation: 達洛碰撞桌角後，大家立刻停止練習。

questions.question: What new rule did they make?
options: Walk, do not run, behind the screen.
questions.explanation: 他們訂下布幕後不能奔跑的規定。

title: Two Ways to Tell a Tale

paragraphs.en: The friends still had to finish the fish’s spoken lines. Daro wanted funny voices and a busy show. Uma wanted words to be few and clear. Sela liked parts of both plans. They talked for a long time without finding a choice that pleased everyone. The festival day was getting close. The little fish looked up at the light above the screen. Sela wanted to show care for guests who liked different kinds of sound. The two versions gave every visitor a chance to choose. Daro asked Sela to choose which scene should have the funny voice.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友們還得完成魚在有聲版裡的台詞。達洛想用滑稽聲音演出熱鬧的戲；烏瑪希望台詞少而清楚。塞拉喜歡兩邊的部分做法。大家談了很久，仍找不到人人滿意的選擇。節日卻已經逼近。小魚抬頭看向布幕上方的光。 塞拉想照顧喜歡不同聲音方式的訪客。 兩種版本給每位訪客選擇的機會。 達洛請塞拉選出哪一場該用有趣聲音。

paragraphs.en: Sela asked each friend to explain what mattered most. Daro wanted children to laugh. Uma wanted quiet guests to feel welcome. Those goals did not have to fight. Sela suggested keeping the two versions they had already tried: one short version with voices and one without voices. The same figures and story could serve both. A common wish was to understand the story without feeling rushed. A neighbor brought her daughter to the small audience test. The girls could enter by the side door if the room became too busy. One child gave Daro a small gift: a drawing of the fish in a hat.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉請每位朋友說明最重視的是什麼。達洛希望孩子能笑；烏瑪希望喜歡安靜的訪客受到歡迎。這兩個目標不必互相打架。塞拉提議保留先前試過的兩個版本：一段簡短配音版、一段無配音版，使用同樣的角色與故事。大家常見的願望是，不必匆忙也能理解故事。 一位鄰居帶女兒來參加小型觀眾測試。 如果房間太忙亂，女孩們可以從側門進來。 一個孩子送達洛一份小禮物，是戴帽子的魚的畫。

paragraphs.en: The group tried the two versions with a small audience. At first, Daro spoke too quickly. He made the sentences shorter. Then Uma moved the silent figures slowly enough for people to follow them. Both versions showed the fish helping a smaller creature find a safe home. The first test was great fun for the children who liked voices. The quiet version was lovely for a visitor who did not want talking. Sela said good morning to the neighbors before starting the early test. It was a pleasure to see guests enjoy two different versions of one story.
paragraphs.zh: 團隊找小觀眾試演兩個版本。一開始達洛說得太快，於是把句子縮短。接著烏瑪慢慢移動無聲版的角色，讓人看得懂。兩個版本都講述魚幫助一個更小的生物找到安全家園。第一輪測試對喜歡配音的孩子來說非常有趣。 無聲版對不想聽人說話的訪客而言很美好。 開始早場測試前，塞拉向鄰居道早安。 看到客人享受同一故事的兩種版本，是件令人愉快的事。

paragraphs.en: After the test, two children gave different answers about which version they liked. One chose the funny voices; the other liked the silent show. Sela smiled. They did not need to agree on one favorite. The show could welcome people with different tastes without asking anyone to change. Daro put a spare stick in his pocket before the next practice. They agreed not to run behind the cloth when changing figures. The festival season brought visitors with many different tastes. Uma made sure the helpers had time to sleep before the final rehearsal. Daro said they could do it the easy way, or they could do it well. Then he smiled and showed them a way that was both simple and careful. The others decided to try it.
paragraphs.zh: 試演後，兩個孩子對喜歡哪一版有不同答案。一個選滑稽配音，另一個喜歡無聲表演。塞拉笑了。大家不需要選出唯一最愛；表演能歡迎不同喜好的人，而不要求誰改變自己。下一次練習前，達洛把備用小棒放入口袋。 他們同意換角色時不在白布後奔跑。 節慶季節帶來喜好各異的訪客。 烏瑪確認幫手在最後排練前有時間睡覺。達洛說，他們可以挑容易的方法，也可以用心做好。接著他笑著示範一個既簡單又謹慎的方法。其他人決定試試看。

paragraphs.en: A tennis player stayed after the test to ask whether she could see the quiet version again. A child beside her wanted the funny voices. Sela showed them the two times, and neither had to say the other was wrong. Daro read his shorter lines while Uma moved the fish without words. The story could still be followed in both ways. They had already tried the idea with a few visitors; now they had to make both versions clear enough for festival night. Sela drew a small fish beside each time on the program. It was the same fish twice, taking a journey that guests could enter in different ways. She left room between the times for everyone to move without hurry.
paragraphs.zh: 一位網球選手在測試後留下，問能否再看安靜版；旁邊的孩子則想聽滑稽配音。塞拉指給他們看兩個時段，誰都不必說另一個選擇錯了。達洛讀縮短的台詞，烏瑪不說話地移動魚，兩種方式仍能讓人跟上故事。他們已經和少數訪客試過點子，接著要讓兩個版本都清楚到能在節慶演出。塞拉在節目單的兩個時間旁各畫一條小魚。那是同一條魚、同一段旅程，客人卻能用不同方式走進去。她也在場次之間留出時間，讓人不必匆忙移動。

questions.question: What did Daro want most?
questions.explanation: 達洛最希望孩子們能開心笑出來。

questions.question: What solution did Sela suggest?
options: Two versions with and without voices.
questions.explanation: 她提出有聲與無聲的兩種版本。

paragraphs.en: An old sea turtle named Hedo visited during practice. He heard the friends speak about the quiet show and said he knew a gentle song from his youth. Sela asked him to sing a little. The notes rose and fell like the waves outside, and the room became still. The bright evening sky made the sea look silver near the hall. Sela wanted to change the music only after asking Hedo's permission. Hedo said his grandfather once sang by the shore on calm nights. A gray shell lay on the table as Daro planned the new figure.
paragraphs.zh: 一位名叫希多的老海龜在練習時來訪。他聽見朋友們談安靜演出，便說記得年輕時的一首溫柔歌謠。塞拉請他唱一點。旋律像門外海浪般起伏，整個房間安靜下來。明亮的傍晚天空，讓廳堂旁的大海看起來像銀色。 塞拉想先徵得希多同意，再改動音樂。 希多說，他的祖父曾在平靜的夜晚於岸邊唱歌。 達洛設計新角色時，桌上放著一枚灰色貝殼。

paragraphs.en: Hedo said his own mother had taught him that song. Sela asked whether they could use it during the spoken version of the play. Hedo thought for a moment. He agreed if they said where the song came from and kept its soft feeling. He did not want them to make it a loud dance tune. Hedo had a habit of humming softly when he watched the waves. Uma asked how the group could help Hedo feel good about sharing the song. Daro wanted the new shell figure to hold still during the first note. The agreement was in Uma's book so every helper could read it.
paragraphs.zh: 希多說，這首歌是母親教他的。塞拉問能否把它用在有聲版表演中。希多想了想，答應了，但希望他們說明歌曲來源，並保留柔和的感覺；他不想把它改成喧鬧舞曲。希多有個習慣，看海浪時會輕輕哼歌。 烏瑪問團隊該怎麼做，才能讓希多放心分享歌曲。 達洛希望新貝殼角色在第一個音響起時保持不動。 約定寫在烏瑪的本子裡，讓每位幫手都能閱讀。

paragraphs.en: Uma wrote down the agreement. Daro made a small figure of a shell that could move with the music. Sela drew the sea behind it, but she kept the picture simple. They tried a few notes and found that the song could guide the fish home without extra words. Sela looked inside the puppet box for a strong stick to move the shell. Hedo spoke of the land and sea that he had known as a child. The words of the song matter to Hedo because they remind him of home. Uma turned the page and wrote the singer's name next to the song.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪把約定記下來。達洛做了一個能隨音樂移動的小貝殼角色。塞拉畫出後方的海，但畫面保持簡單。他們試唱幾個音，發現歌曲不必加太多話，就能引導魚回家。塞拉在玩偶箱裡找能移動貝殼的牢固小棒。 希多談起自己童年熟悉的土地與海。 這首歌的詞對希多很重要，因為讓他想起家。 烏瑪翻頁，把歌者姓名寫在歌曲旁。

paragraphs.en: Hedo watched the test. He said the song sounded like the one he remembered, though the setting was new. Sela thanked him and asked again if he felt comfortable sharing it. Hedo said yes. His smile made her understand that respect was not only a note written on paper; it was a real talk with a person. Daro cut a clean piece of paper to make the shell's moving arm. A pig from the market listened and said the soft tune felt calm. Sela colored one small wave pink for the drawing in the program. Uma wrote a short report on how the song was used with permission.
paragraphs.zh: 希多看了測試。他說，歌曲聽起來仍像記憶中的那首，只是場景變了。塞拉道謝，又問他是否仍願意分享。希多說願意。他的笑容讓塞拉明白，尊重不只是寫在紙上的備註，而是人與人之間真正的對話。達洛剪出一片乾淨的紙，製作貝殼會動的手臂。 一隻來自市場的豬聽了，說柔和曲調讓人平靜。 塞拉在節目單畫上了一道粉紅色小浪。 烏瑪寫了一份短報告，說明歌曲如何在同意下被使用。

paragraphs.en: Hedo listened once more before he left. Daro kept the last note soft, just as they had agreed. Sela thought the song was wonderful, but she did not ask to put it into every scene. The silent version would stay silent, and the spoken version would name where the song came from. Uma showed Hedo the new line in the program. He read it slowly and asked her to keep his mother's place in the story of the song. She did. Outside, the sea was very quiet beneath the evening sky. Hedo began the tune again as he walked home. This time Sela did not reach for her pencil. She simply listened to him go.
paragraphs.zh: 希多離開前又聽了一次。達洛照約定把最後一個音唱得輕柔。塞拉覺得歌曲美妙，卻沒有要求每場戲都加上它。無聲版仍會無聲，有聲版則說明歌的來源。烏瑪給希多看節目單上的新句子。他慢慢讀，請她在歌曲來歷裡，保留母親的位置；她照做了。晚空下，大海格外安靜。希多回家時又輕輕唱起曲子。這次塞拉沒有拿鉛筆，只靜靜聽他走遠。

questions.question: Who taught Hedo the song?
questions.explanation: 希多說歌曲是母親教他的。

questions.question: What did Hedo ask the group to do?
options: Credit its source and keep it gentle.
questions.explanation: 希多希望標明來源並保留柔和的曲風。

paragraphs.en: The day of the first full test arrived. Uma asked everyone to come early and stand in the right place. Daro laid out the figures in the order they would appear. Sela checked the script and took a seat at the back. For the first time, the whole play would run from beginning to end. Sela said the best time to test every scene was before the festival day. Daro helped build a simple stand to keep the paper figures in order. The group sat in a circle after the full test and listened to each other. A soft drum beat marked the beginning of the spoken play.
paragraphs.zh: 第一次完整試演的日子到了。烏瑪請大家提早來，站在正確的位置。達洛把角色依出場順序排好。塞拉檢查劇本，坐在最後一排。這是第一次從頭到尾演完整齣戲。塞拉說，節日前就是測試每一場戲的最好時機。 達洛幫忙搭一個簡單架子，讓紙角色依序擺放。 完整測試後，團隊圍坐成圈，彼此聆聽。 一聲輕柔鼓點標示了有聲戲的開始。

paragraphs.en: The fish came out of its small home and saw the wide sea. It met a shell keeper and learned to ask a question. Then the story moved too slowly. Daro had trouble changing two figures behind the cloth. Sela wrote down the problem instead of stopping the play. Uma wrote down everything that had worked in the first full run. Daro was excited when the fish finally moved across the whole screen. Sela thanked each friend who had helped with the test. She put her hand on the table to show Daro where to stand.
paragraphs.zh: 魚離開小小的家，看見寬廣大海。牠遇見貝殼守護者，學會提出問題。但接下來故事變得太慢。達洛在布幕後更換兩個角色時出了問題。塞拉先把問題記下，而沒有立刻停戲。烏瑪寫下第一次完整試演中所有順利的部分。 魚終於游過整面布幕時，達洛很興奮。 塞拉感謝每位協助測試的朋友。 她把手放在桌上，向達洛指出應站的位置。

paragraphs.en: When the last shadow left the screen, the friends sat in a circle. Each person spoke about one thing that worked and one thing that needed care. No one laughed at another person's trouble. Uma said the best part was the clear ending. Daro said the hard part was moving the figures quickly. The test gave the group more knowledge about the timing of each scene. A lawyer from town offered to move chairs, just like the other helpers. Most visitors in the small test could follow the fish's journey. Sela remembered her mother showing her how to draw a fish as a child.
paragraphs.zh: 最後一個影子離開布幕後，朋友們圍坐成圈。每個人說一件做得好的事，以及一件需要改進的事。沒有人嘲笑別人的困難。烏瑪認為結尾最清楚，達洛則說換角色太慢。測試讓團隊更了解每場戲的時間安排。 鎮上一位律師自願搬椅子，和其他幫手一樣。 小型測試的大多數訪客都能跟上魚的旅程。 塞拉想起小時候母親教她畫魚。

paragraphs.en: They tried a new layout with the figures in a simple line. Daro did not have to reach across the table anymore. Sela also removed one scene that repeated an idea already shown. The play became shorter, but its meaning did not change. The friends agreed that taking something out could make the story stronger. An old table had held the figures through many days of careful practice. Daro kept a pair of small sticks ready for the next part. Uma asked everyone to remember which scene came after the shell keeper. A seed in a small pot grew beside the hall window during their work.
paragraphs.zh: 他們試著把角色排成簡單的一列，達洛就不必跨過桌面伸手了。塞拉也刪掉一場重複表達相同意思的戲。表演變短，但意義沒變。朋友們同意，有時刪減反而讓故事更有力量。一張舊桌子在許多天的細心練習中承載著角色。 達洛備好一對小棒，準備下一段。 烏瑪請大家記住貝殼守護者之後是哪一場。 工作期間，廳堂窗旁小盆裡的一顆種子發芽了。

paragraphs.en: Daro did not throw the second figure across the table when Uma called its part. He could reach it from the new place and bring it on slowly while she spoke the short line. Sela watched from the back. The missing scene had not left a hole in the fish's journey. It had given the next scene time to be seen. They would test that change once more before printing the final program. Daro asked whether taking something out could really make the play better. Sela pointed to the two figures, now waiting within reach of his hands. The wise choice was not always to make more. Sometimes it was to let the part they already loved become clear.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪念到下一個角色時，達洛沒有把紙偶扔過桌面。他從新位置就拿得到，能在她說短台詞時慢慢帶它上場。塞拉坐後排看。刪掉的場景沒有在魚的旅程留下缺口，反而讓下一幕有時間被看清楚。印最終節目單前，他們會再試一次。達洛問，少一點東西真的能讓戲變好嗎？塞拉指向已在他手邊等候的兩個角色。有智慧的選擇，不一定是做更多；有時，是讓原本喜歡的部分變得清楚。

questions.question: What made the story slow during the first full test?
options: Changing two figures behind the cloth.
questions.explanation: 換兩個角色的過程太慢。

questions.question: How did Sela make the play shorter?
questions.explanation: 她刪掉一場重複的戲。

paragraphs.en: Two days before the public test, a small part of the shell puppet broke. Daro had made it from old paper, and the edge was weak. He looked upset. Sela told him they could fix it, but she also asked what would happen if something broke during the real show. The room fell quiet. Daro found a long strip of tape along the edge of the work table. A bad tear in the old paper made the shell figure hard to move. Uma brought bread for a short break before they made the spare fish. They took a bus to the craft store for a few safe supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 公開測試前兩天，貝殼角色的一小部分壞了。達洛用舊紙製作，邊緣不夠牢固。他看起來很沮喪。塞拉說可以修，但也問，如果正式演出時壞了怎麼辦？房間頓時安靜。達洛在工作桌邊找到一長條膠帶。 舊紙的一道嚴重裂口，讓貝殼角色難以移動。 做備用魚前，烏瑪帶來麵包讓大家短暫休息。 他們搭公車去工藝店，買一些安全材料。

paragraphs.en: Uma found an empty box and wrote 'For Tomorrow' on it. They put extra paper, safe tape, spare sticks, and a small light inside. Daro made one more fish figure. It was not as pretty as the first, but it could tell the same story if the main one failed. The backup case held clean paper, sticks, and a simple lamp. They planned a small dinner after the work instead of staying too late. Daro counted a dozen small sticks and picked the strongest ones. Uma said the idea of a backup box was excellent for a short live show.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪找來一個空箱子，寫上「明天備用」。大家放入多餘的紙、安全膠帶、備用小棒和小燈。達洛又做了一條魚，雖然不如原本漂亮，但如果主角偶壞掉，仍能說同一個故事。備用盒裡有乾淨紙張、小棒和一盞簡單燈。 他們打算做完事吃簡單晚餐，而不是留到太晚。 達洛數了十二根小棒，挑出最牢固的。 烏瑪說，對現場短演出而言，備用箱是很棒的點子。

paragraphs.en: They practiced changing a broken figure without making the whole room wait too long. One person would tell a short line from the story while the other made the change. Sela asked them not to hurry past the safe path. The backup plan was useful only if everyone could follow it. Sela felt a headache coming and took a short rest away from the light. The movement of the fish had to remain slow when changing to the spare figure. The next test would include a practice change from the broken figure. Perhaps a second fish would look different, but it could tell the same story.
paragraphs.zh: 他們練習在角色壞掉時替換，不讓整間房的人等太久。一人說一段簡短旁白，另一人換道具。塞拉提醒大家不要急著跨過安全走道。只有人人都能照做，備案才有用。塞拉有點頭痛，便離開燈光短暫休息。 換上備用角色時，魚的動作仍需保持緩慢。 下一次測試會包含更換損壞角色的練習。 也許第二條魚看起來不同，但仍能說同一個故事。

paragraphs.en: A child visiting the hall asked why the new fish had a different tail. Daro said it was a spare and showed how it moved. The child liked both. Sela laughed and saw that a perfect match was not needed for a kind story. What mattered was keeping the meaning clear. Uma used a ruler to keep the new figure the same height as the old one. Daro covered the sharp edge of the stick so no helper would be hurt. A child asked if something could still go wrong after all the tests. They put safe tape near the top of the backup box for easy use.
paragraphs.zh: 一個來訪的孩子問，為何新魚的尾巴不一樣。達洛說那是備用的，並示範它怎麼動。孩子兩條魚都喜歡。塞拉笑了，發現溫柔的故事不需要每個道具都完全一樣，清楚傳達意義才重要。烏瑪用尺讓新角色保持與舊角色相同的高度。 達洛包住小棒的尖邊，以免幫手受傷。 有個孩子問，做了所有測試後是否仍可能出錯。 他們把安全膠帶放在備用箱上方，方便使用。

paragraphs.en: It was Daro's turn to close the spare box. He set a small toy fish beside the new figure, then tried taking each one out without moving the lamp. A child watching from the door asked if the fish could travel to the zoo for another show one day. Sela smiled, but said they first had one festival to prepare for. Uma put the box on the list beside the other things to check before leaving. Sela asked them to wake her only for a real problem tonight. The spare materials could wait safely here. On the way home, she was able to think about dinner instead of trying to carry every broken paper tail in her head.
paragraphs.zh: 這次輪到達洛收備用箱。他把小玩具魚放在新紙偶旁，試著不移動燈就逐一取出。門口觀看的孩子問，魚將來能不能去動物園再演一次。塞拉笑了，但說他們得先準備好眼前這場節慶。烏瑪把備用箱列進離開前的檢查清單。塞拉請朋友們今晚只在真正出問題時才叫醒她。備用材料可以安全地留在這裡。回家路上，她終於能想晚餐，不必把每一條破紙尾巴都扛在腦中。

questions.question: Why did Uma prepare an extra box?
options: For backup materials if something broke.
questions.explanation: 備用箱是為了應付道具損壞。

questions.question: Did the backup fish need to look exactly like the first fish?
options: Yes, or the play would end.
No, it only needed to tell the story clearly.
It had to be much larger.
questions.explanation: 即使外觀略不同，只要能清楚說故事就可以。

paragraphs.en: Uma learned that the last bus left the bay earlier than she had thought. Two helpers lived far from the hall and could not stay until night. Sela first wanted to ask them to work later anyway. Then she remembered that a show should not make the people who helped it lose their way home. Daro wanted to become a better helper, not someone who always worked late. One tired helper said he needed to get home before going to bed. Uma stood beside the bus sign to check the last departure time. Sela did not ask anyone to carry heavy boxes across town at night.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪發現，海灣最後一班公車比她想的更早離開。兩位幫手住得遠，無法留到夜裡。塞拉起初想請他們晚點再走，但又想到，表演不該讓幫忙的人沒車回家。達洛想成為更好的幫手，而不是永遠加班的人。 一位疲憊幫手說，他需要在睡前先回到家。 烏瑪站在公車站牌旁，確認末班車發車時間。 塞拉沒有要求任何人在夜裡扛重箱走過小鎮。

paragraphs.en: They looked at the list of jobs and moved some tasks to the afternoon. Helpers who needed the bus could work while the sun was still high. Other friends who lived nearby took the short evening jobs. Everyone agreed to the change before it went on the plan. Uma used a computer at the town office to check the bus schedule. The evening air became cool as the helpers finished their short jobs. Daro put a clean cup on the table for everyone to share water safely. Sela asked each helper to drink water before leaving the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 他們查看工作清單，把一些任務移到下午。要搭公車的幫手能在太陽還高時工作，住附近的人則接手晚間短任務。每個人同意後，才把更動寫進計畫。烏瑪用鎮公所的電腦查看公車時刻表。 幫手完成短工作時，傍晚空氣變涼了。 達洛在桌上放了乾淨杯子，讓大家方便喝水。 塞拉請每位幫手離開廳堂前先喝水。

paragraphs.en: A young helper said he did not want his family to worry. Uma helped him check the bus time without making fun of him. Sela felt sorry she had nearly asked him to stay late. She told the group that the plan would now include a clear time for going home. A fat sea bird rested on the roof while the last bus approached. Uma put away the food left from the afternoon break. Every helper needed a safe way home after finishing the evening tasks. Nobody played loud music during the late practice in the quiet hall.
paragraphs.zh: 一位年輕幫手說，不希望家人擔心。烏瑪陪他確認公車時間，沒有取笑他。塞拉對自己差點要求他晚留感到抱歉，於是告訴團隊，以後計畫裡會清楚列出回家時間。末班公車靠近時，一隻胖胖的海鳥停在屋頂休息。 烏瑪收起下午休息時剩下的食物。 每位幫手完成晚間工作後，都需要安全的回家方式。 安靜廳堂的晚間練習中，沒有人播放大聲音樂。

paragraphs.en: They practiced one final change of the lights in the afternoon. It worked well, even with fewer helpers. Daro learned that doing a job alone for a short time was different from being left alone with too much work. The team talked about what each person could truly do. Daro joked that the figures looked like magic when the light moved. A short practice in the afternoon was enough for the light change. They had to be quick with the last check but not careless. A helper from the nearby school offered to come in the afternoon instead.
paragraphs.zh: 他們在下午練習最後一次燈光切換。即使幫手較少，仍然順利。達洛學到，短時間獨自做一件事，和被丟下承擔過多工作是兩回事。大家討論每個人真正能負擔的工作。達洛開玩笑說，燈光移動時，角色看起來像魔法。 下午短短練習就足以測試燈光切換。 最後檢查得快一點，但不能粗心。 附近學校的一位幫手願意改在下午來。

paragraphs.en: At the stop, one volunteer's son waited to walk his father home after the bus ride. Sela waved from the hall door. She had changed the work list, not asked the family to change its whole evening for her show. The nearby helpers had agreed to finish the small jobs that remained. Daro used a soft tie around the spare paper and put it within reach for tomorrow. Without the noise of moving chairs, Sela could hear the bus leave. For a moment she wanted to call everyone back and try the lights again. Instead, she checked the list. That test was finished. The helpers had done what they promised, and now they should be allowed to go home.
paragraphs.zh: 站牌旁，一名志工的兒子等著父親搭車回來，再陪他走回家。塞拉在廳堂門邊揮手。她修改的是工作表，沒有要求一個家庭為表演改掉整個晚上。住附近的幫手同意完成剩下的小工作。達洛用柔軟束帶固定備用紙，放在明天容易拿到的位置。搬椅子的聲音停了，塞拉聽見公車離開。她一度想叫大家回來，再試一次燈；最後只看清單。那項測試已完成。幫手做到了承諾的事，如今也該能回家。

questions.question: What did Uma discover about transport?
options: The last bus left earlier than expected.
There was no road to the bay.
questions.explanation: 最後一班公車比原先預估更早離開。

questions.question: How did the team change its schedule?
options: It moved some jobs to the afternoon.
It made all workers stay late.
questions.explanation: 團隊把部分任務改到下午進行。

paragraphs.en: On the day of the open practice, Sela arrived early and checked every chair. The lamp worked, the figures were ready, and the door stood open. But no visitors came. After half an hour, Daro asked if everyone had forgotten the event. Sela felt her face grow warm with worry. At first, no guests appear at the open practice, and Sela feels worried. The chairs stayed empty because the sign outside showed the wrong date. An elephant who worked near the square offered to tell neighbors the right date. Daro said the next test could still be exciting if people heard about it.
paragraphs.zh: 公開彩排那天，塞拉很早就到，檢查每張椅子。燈沒問題、角色準備好了，門也開著，卻沒有訪客出現。半小時後，達洛問是不是大家都忘了。塞拉急得臉都熱了。起初，公開彩排沒有客人出現，塞拉很擔心。 椅子空著，因為外面告示寫錯日期。 在廣場附近工作的象願意告訴鄰居正確日期。 達洛說，只要大家知道，下一次測試仍會很令人期待。

paragraphs.en: Uma looked at the sign outside. Its date was wrong. The town had printed the number for the next day. Sela wanted to blame the office at once, but Uma said the group should first check their own program. It showed the right date, yet they had not checked the public sign. Uma told Sela that an empty room did not mean their idea had to fail. Only a fool would blame guests for a sign they did not make. Sela said they should go to Oren and ask for a corrected sign. Daro put the sharp knife away before speaking with Oren about the date.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪查看外面的告示，發現日期錯了。鎮上把日期印成隔天。塞拉立刻想責怪公所，但烏瑪說應先檢查自己的節目單。節目單日期是對的，只是他們沒有確認公開告示。烏瑪告訴塞拉，空房間不代表點子注定失敗。 只有傻瓜才會因為不是訪客做的告示而怪罪他們。 塞拉說，他們應去找歐倫，請他更正告示。 向歐倫討論日期前，達洛先收好尖刀。

paragraphs.en: Sela asked Oren for help. He came, saw the mistake, and agreed to put up a correct sign. The group also spoke to people in the square and told them both dates clearly. They did not say the empty room proved that nobody cared. It proved only that their message had been wrong. Uma said being lazy about checking signs could waste many people's time. Sela said they did not need a million visitors to learn from a test. For a moment, she felt alone in the empty hall. A child drew a mountain on the back of a spare paper ticket.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉請歐倫幫忙。歐倫來看見錯誤後，同意換上正確告示。團隊也到廣場向人們清楚說明兩個日期。他們沒有把空廳堂解讀成沒有人在乎；這只能證明消息寫錯了。烏瑪說，懶得檢查告示可能浪費許多人的時間。 塞拉說，他們不需要一百萬名觀眾也能從測試學習。 有一瞬間，她在空廳堂裡感到孤單。 一名孩子在備用紙票背面畫了一座山。

paragraphs.en: They decided to hold a short open practice again the next day. Uma called the few neighbors who had asked about the show. Daro used the empty time to check the figure order. Sela sat in the first row and reminded herself that a mistake could be corrected without making anyone feel small. Nobody knew about the new date until the friends shared it clearly.
