Uma went out to the square to tell people about the new practice. There was a small pool near the square where children often played. One visitor asked a question about the correct starting time.
paragraphs.zh: 他們決定隔天再開放一次短彩排。烏瑪聯絡先前詢問過的幾位鄰居。達洛利用空檔檢查角色順序。塞拉坐在第一排提醒自己：錯誤可以被修正，不必讓任何人難堪。朋友們清楚公告前，沒有人知道新日期。 烏瑪出去廣場，告訴人們新的彩排時間。 廣場旁有一座小水池，孩子們常在那裡玩。 一位訪客詢問正確開始時間的問題。

paragraphs.en: Before the six guests came, Uma changed the wet mat by the door. A musician arrived with a violin, and Sela showed him which version had sound. He agreed to put the case down during the quiet one. There was no need to send him away; he could choose what he wished to watch. Afterward, the friends shared soup and read the guests' questions. Daro added a round fish eye to the corrected sign. Sela checked the date herself before he put it outside. Yesterday she had looked at empty chairs and heard failure. Today there were six different voices to answer. A wrong sign had not told her whether the story mattered. It had told her to read the sign.
paragraphs.zh: 六位客人到場前，烏瑪換掉門邊濕墊。一位樂手帶小提琴來，塞拉說明哪個版本有聲音；他同意安靜場時把琴盒放下。他不必被請走，可以自己選想看的場次。結束後，朋友們喝湯、讀客人的問題。達洛在更正告示上加一隻圓魚眼，拿出去前，塞拉親自核對日期。昨天她看空椅子，聽見的是失敗；今天卻有六個不同的聲音可以回答。錯誤告示不能證明故事是否重要，它只提醒她，得把告示讀清楚。

questions.question: Why were the chairs empty on the first practice day?
options: The public sign had the wrong date.
The fish was lost at sea.
questions.explanation: 公開告示印錯日期，造成訪客沒來。

questions.question: What did the group do next?
options: It corrected the sign and tried again.
questions.explanation: 他們更正告示，並於隔天重新開放彩排。

paragraphs.en: Five days before the festival, Oren held a public meeting about the hall. Some people wanted to use it for storage. Others had seen the open practice and hoped it could stay a place for neighbors. Sela listened carefully. She knew that loving an idea did not give her the right to decide for the whole town. A small group of neighbors came early for the public meeting. Uma said the hall should always be safe for anyone who entered. A local club offered to help with the next month's public event. Oren explained the cost of keeping the hall clean and open.
paragraphs.zh: 節日前五天，歐倫召開廳堂用途的公開會議。有些人想把廳堂當倉庫，另一些人看過公開彩排，希望它保留為鄰居活動的空間。塞拉仔細聽。她知道喜愛某個點子，不代表有權替全鎮決定。一小群鄰居提早來參加公開會議。 烏瑪說，廳堂對每個進來的人都應保持安全。 當地一個社團願意協助下個月的公開活動。 歐倫說明保持廳堂乾淨開放的成本。

paragraphs.en: Uma shared the real cost of the show and the number of volunteers. She did not claim that the event had already changed everyone's life. Daro spoke about using old paper and making safe figures. Sela explained why the quiet and spoken versions mattered to different visitors. Sela said it was good to hear different ideas before a town decision. Someone asked if a guitar class could use the hall after the festival. The next town holiday would bring visitors who needed a quiet place. Uma thanked a kind neighbor who had helped count the seats.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪分享演出的實際成本和志工人數，沒有誇稱活動已改變所有人的生活。達洛談到如何利用舊紙和製作安全角色。塞拉則解釋，為何安靜版與旁白版對不同訪客都重要。塞拉說，鎮上決定前聽不同想法是好事。 有人問，節日後吉他課能否使用廳堂。 下一個小鎮假日將帶來需要安靜空間的訪客。 烏瑪感謝一位幫忙數座位的好心鄰居。

paragraphs.en: A shop owner asked if the hall would always belong to Sela's group. Sela said no. She wanted an open room that other neighbors could use for their own ideas. Oren suggested a trial month after the festival. If people cared for the space, the town could discuss a longer plan. The meeting gave everyone a chance to talk about the hall. Daro said he would miss working in the hall if it became storage only. Oren suggested a trial month before making a longer promise. A small mouse listened quietly from the last chair in the room. A few neighbors stopped to watch. Some had advice, and some simply smiled. Sela thanked them all, but she made sure the group agreed before changing the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 一位店主問，廳堂以後是否永遠屬於塞拉團隊。塞拉說不是。她希望有個開放空間，讓其他鄰居也能提出自己的活動。歐倫建議節日後先試行一個月；若大家願意好好使用，再討論長期計畫。這場會議給每個人機會談廳堂的未來。 達洛說，如果廳堂只變倉庫，他會想念在這裡工作的日子。 歐倫提議先試行一個月，再做長期承諾。 一隻小老鼠在房間最後一張椅子上安靜聽著。幾位鄰居停下來觀看。有的人給建議，有的人只是微笑。塞拉一一道謝，但在修改計畫前，她仍確認團隊已經同意。

paragraphs.en: The meeting did not end with everyone thinking the same thing. A few people still wanted more storage. The town agreed to keep a small room for boxes and use the main hall for the one-month trial. Sela felt that a fair answer could leave room for different needs. A national art day was coming, and one group hoped to hold a drawing event. Sela said the hall was a place for more than one kind of work. The groups could share the room by planning different days. Uma asked people to stop speaking over each other so all could be heard.
paragraphs.zh: 會議結束時，大家仍沒有完全相同的想法。有些人依然需要存放物品。鎮上同意留一個小房間放箱子，把主要廳堂用於一個月的試行。塞拉覺得，公平的答案可以容納不同需求。全國藝術日即將來到，一個團體希望辦繪畫活動。 塞拉說，廳堂是能容納不只一種活動的地方。 團體可以安排不同日子來共享房間。 烏瑪請大家不要互相打斷，以便每個聲音都被聽見。

paragraphs.en: A young teacher stayed to ask about a drawing afternoon during the trial month. Sela showed her where the screen could stand when it was not in use. Near the back door, Oren pointed out the smaller room where a truck could bring the storage boxes. The plan had to make space for things as well as for people. Daro asked again whether this meant they had won. Sela looked at the teacher measuring a table and at Oren checking the storage door. Nobody had got every room for themselves. They had found a way to begin. She gave the teacher a blank idea card. There would be other stories here after the fish had gone back into its box.
paragraphs.zh: 一位年輕老師留下，詢問試行月能否辦繪畫下午。塞拉指出布幕不用時可收在哪裡。後門旁，歐倫指著較小的房間，說卡車可把儲藏箱送到那裡。計畫不只得容納人，也得容納物品。達洛又問，這算他們贏了嗎？塞拉看老師量桌子、看歐倫檢查儲藏門。沒有人獨占所有房間，他們只是找到可以開始的方法。她遞給老師一張空白點子卡。紙魚收回箱子後，這裡還會有其他故事。

questions.question: What did the town agree to after the meeting?
options: A one-month public trial for the main hall.
To sell the hall to Sela.
questions.explanation: 鎮上同意主要廳堂試行公共使用一個月。

questions.question: Did every neighbor agree at the meeting?
options: Yes, all wanted the same thing.
questions.explanation: 仍有部分居民希望保留儲藏空間。

paragraphs.en: The town sent an engineer to check the hall before festival day. She looked at the floor, the doors, the tables, and the lamp. Sela was nervous because she had never planned an event this large. The engineer explained what she was checking and asked the friends to show their plan. The engineer said the group had the ability to make small safe changes. No one left clothes on the floor near the exit after the inspection. A dead battery would stop the lamp, so Daro prepared a safe spare. Sela used a pencil to draw the clear walking path for the engineer. The work was small enough to finish before sunset. That mattered to the group. They did not want to make big promises and leave the hard parts for someone else to fix.
paragraphs.zh: 節日前，鎮上派工程師來檢查廳堂。她查看地板、門、桌子和燈。塞拉很緊張，因為她從未規劃過這麼大的活動。工程師說明檢查內容，請朋友們展示計畫。工程師說，團隊有能力做出小而安全的調整。 檢查後，沒有人把衣物留在出口附近的地板上。 電池沒電會讓燈停下來，所以達洛準備了安全的備用電池。 塞拉用鉛筆畫出走道，給工程師查看。這項工作小到可以在日落前完成。這對團隊很重要。他們不想許下很大的承諾，卻把困難的部分留給別人處理。

paragraphs.en: Uma showed the seating drawing and the clear paths. Daro explained how the lamp stood on a firm table and used a battery. Sela showed how the two short versions of the play would work. The engineer asked them to move one shelf away from the exit, and they did it at once. The engineer checked every door before looking at the lamp. The floor was clean and dry when the visitors came to inspect it. A small glass of water was kept far from the electric lamp. Daro said the fish story did not need a god or goddess to solve every problem.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪拿出座位配置圖和通道安排；達洛解釋燈固定放在穩固桌上、使用電池；塞拉示範兩個短版本的戲。工程師要求他們把一個架子移離出口，大家立刻照做。工程師先檢查所有門，再看燈。 訪客來檢查時，地板乾淨又乾燥。 一小杯水放在遠離電燈的地方。 達洛說，魚的故事不需要神或女神替角色解決每個問題。

paragraphs.en: Next, the engineer checked the light from the back row and the boards near the front. She said the setup was good for a short event after the small change. Oren wrote down her advice. Sela did not call the room perfect; she called it ready for the planned number of guests. A hungry helper ate a small snack outside during the inspection. Uma said they could move the shelf later only if the engineer agreed. They had a lot of chairs but used only the safe number. Sela was not mad when the engineer asked for another small change.
paragraphs.zh: 接著，工程師從後排檢查燈光，也查看前方的板子。她說，調整完小問題後，這個配置適合短活動。歐倫記下建議。塞拉沒有說房間完美，只說它已能迎接預定人數的訪客。一位肚子餓的幫手在檢查期間到外面吃點心。 烏瑪說，只有工程師同意，才可以稍後移動架子。 他們有很多椅子，卻只使用符合安全人數的數量。 工程師要求再做一個小調整時，塞拉沒有生氣。

paragraphs.en: The group counted chairs and matched them to the paper tickets. They left room for people who needed more space. Uma made sure no one promised extra seats after the safe number was reached. Sela saw that welcome sometimes meant telling someone to return for the next show. Uma used simple mathematics to compare the number of seats with tickets. The program lay on the table near the entrance for visitors to read. The price of entry was zero, as the group had promised. The engineer reminded them that the hall was a public room.
paragraphs.zh: 團隊數了椅子，與紙票數量核對，並為需要較大空間的人保留位置。烏瑪確認達到安全人數後，不會再承諾額外座位。塞拉明白，歡迎有時也包含請人下一場再來。烏瑪用簡單數學核對座位數和票數。 節目單放在入口旁桌上，讓訪客閱讀。 入場價格是零，正如團隊承諾的。 工程師提醒他們，廳堂是公共空間。

paragraphs.en: Uma asked the friends to sit in the last row while she stood by the exit. From there, Sela could see the clear path between the chairs. These places would stay empty even if more guests arrived than they expected. That was the hardest thing to promise, because she wanted everyone to come inside. Daro pointed to the second performance time on the program. A guest could wait for that one instead of standing in a doorway. The engineer's notes would stay with the room plan. When the hall was used by another group, they would not have to guess why a shelf had been moved. Sela put the plan by the door, ready for people rather than only for the inspector.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪站在出口，請朋友們坐最後一排。塞拉從那裡看得見椅子間的通暢走道。即使客人超過預期，那些位置也會留空。這項承諾最難，因為她希望人人都能進來。達洛指向節目單上的第二場時間：客人可以等那一場，不必站在門口。工程師的建議會與配置圖放一起。換別的團體使用時，也不必猜為什麼架子曾被移動。塞拉把圖放在門旁，不只準備給檢查者，也準備給真正使用房間的人。

questions.question: What did the engineer ask them to move?
questions.explanation: 工程師要求移開出口附近的架子。

questions.question: Why did the friends count the tickets?
options: To keep the room within a safe guest number.
questions.explanation: 紙票數量用來控制安全入場人數。

paragraphs.en: During the last school visit, a small child named Nemi watched the fish meet the shell keeper. Nemi raised one hand and said the fish should not simply be given the way home. It should learn to ask another fish for help. Sela had not thought of that ending, and she liked it. Nemi wanted to act out a short part of the fish story with a paper figure. The child's action made Sela see the ending in a new way. After the school visit, the group worked on a new last scene. Sela said art could be a gift that people made together. Everyone had a different job, and each job mattered. Even the quiet work behind the cloth helped the show come alive. Sela promised to name every helper when the day came.
paragraphs.zh: 最後一次學校參訪時，名叫妮米的小孩看魚遇見貝殼守護者。妮米舉手說，魚不該只是被告知回家的路，而應學會向另一條魚求助。塞拉原本沒想到這種結尾，卻很喜歡。妮米想用紙角色演出魚故事的一小段。 孩子的行動讓塞拉用新方式看待結局。 學校參訪後，團隊著手做新的最後一場。 塞拉說，藝術可以是大家一起創作的禮物。每個人有不同的工作，而每份工作都很重要。就連白布後面安靜的工作，也能讓表演活起來。塞拉答應在演出當天說出每位幫手的名字。

paragraphs.en: Sela asked Nemi whether the group could use the idea in the show. The child wanted to think about it. Sela said there was no hurry and no need to answer yes. After talking to a teacher, Nemi said the group could use it if the program named the child as a helper. A big sheet of card held the two fish figures for the final scene. Nemi wore a soft cap while watching the rehearsal. The child put an ear close to the teacher to hear the quiet answer. Even a small change could make the end of the play stronger.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉問妮米能否在表演裡使用這個點子。孩子想先考慮。塞拉說不急，也不一定要答應。妮米和老師討論後表示可以，只希望節目單把自己列為幫手。一張大卡紙放著結尾場景的兩條魚角色。 妮米看排練時戴著柔軟帽子。 孩子把耳朵靠近老師，聽清楚輕聲的回答。 即使是小小修改，也能讓結尾更有力量。

paragraphs.en: Daro made another tiny fish from a thick piece of card. Uma added one short line to the spoken version and a clear gesture to the quiet version. The group tested the change. Now the first fish did not solve everything alone. It learned to speak, listen, and work with another fish. Sela did not expect a new idea from the youngest visitor. Daro moved a bit of paper hair from the second fish's head. Sela said it was important to ask Nemi before using the idea. The story did not need to kill a bad fish to make the ending exciting.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛用厚卡紙做了另一條小魚。烏瑪在旁白版加了一句簡短台詞，也在安靜版加上清楚手勢。團隊測試改動。現在第一條魚不再獨自解決所有事，而是學會說、聽，並和另一條魚合作。塞拉沒料到最年幼的訪客會提出新點子。 達洛把第二條魚頭上的一小撮紙做的頭髮移開。 塞拉說，採用點子之前先問妮米很重要。 故事不需要殺死壞魚，就能有精彩結尾。

paragraphs.en: Sela smiled at the new ending. It sounded like the work behind the stage. The show had started with her idea, yet many other minds had shaped it. She thanked Nemi and added the name to the program, just as the child had asked. The teacher saw that Nemi felt proud. Nemi took the new lesson home: a child could help make art. Uma put a small mark beside Nemi's name on the updated program. Nemi said no to using the idea until after talking with a teacher. Sela looked over the program before it was printed again.
paragraphs.zh: 塞拉看著新結尾微笑。它很像舞台背後的合作過程。表演從她的點子開始，卻由許多人的想法共同塑造。她謝謝妮米，照約定把名字加進節目單。老師看得出妮米很驕傲。妮米把新學到的事帶回家：孩子也能協助創作藝術。 烏瑪在更新的節目單上，於妮米名字旁做了小記號。 妮米先說不，直到和老師討論後才同意使用點子。 再次印製前，塞拉仔細看過節目單。

paragraphs.en: A snake from the school group stayed to watch them raise the second fish. Its shadow met the first one slowly, leaving time for the question before the answer. Nemi nodded from the back. This was the change the child had agreed to share. Daro asked whether they should make the two fish move faster for festival night. Sela said this practice was a chance to study what people understood, not only what they could make the figures do. They tried the same short part again. Nemi could follow it without the teacher explaining. When the group left, Sela kept the child's name beside the new scene. An idea could be small and still change where a whole story went.
paragraphs.zh: 學校團體裡一隻蛇留下來，看他們慢慢舉起第二條魚。兩道影子相遇，答案之前，先為問題留出時間。妮米在後排點頭。這正是孩子同意分享的修改。達洛問，節慶當晚是否該移動得更快。塞拉說，排練是研究人們理解了什麼的機會，不只是測試紙偶能怎麼動。他們再試同一小段，妮米不用老師解釋也能跟上。團體離開後，塞拉仍把孩子姓名寫在新場景旁。點子很小，也能改變整個故事前進的方向。

questions.question: What did Nemi suggest for the fish?
options: It should ask another fish for help.
questions.explanation: 妮米建議讓魚學會向另一條魚求助。

questions.question: What did Nemi want in return for using the idea?
options: A name in the program as a helper.
questions.explanation: 妮米希望在節目單上被列為幫手。

paragraphs.en: Festival evening finally came. Neighbors arrived with bags, light jackets, and happy faces. A few visitors needed help at the entrance, and Uma showed them the clear path. Sela stood behind the cloth and heard the gentle sounds of people taking their seats. She was afraid of making a mistake, but she was ready to begin. The hall was almost full when the first guests arrived for the festival. A family hoped to buy a small picture of the fish after the show. Uma reminded the helpers to be careful as they set down the lamps. A child brought a carrot snack and ate it outside the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 節慶傍晚終於來了。鄰居們提著袋子、穿著薄外套，帶著笑容到場。有些訪客需要入口協助，烏瑪帶他們走安全通道。塞拉站在白布後，聽見人們輕聲入座。她怕出錯，但已準備開始。第一批客人到來時，廳堂幾乎坐滿了。 一個家庭希望演後買一張魚的畫。 烏瑪提醒幫手，放燈時要小心。 一個孩子帶了胡蘿蔔點心，在廳堂外吃。

paragraphs.en: In the spoken version, Daro gave the fish a soft voice. Hedo's song came during the scene by the sea. The children laughed when the fish in a hat turned the wrong way. When the little second fish appeared, Nemi sat up straight and smiled. Sela knew that the child had seen the idea become real. Sela hoped everyone would enjoy the two ways of watching the same play. Daro moved his foot away from the light box before switching it on. Uma was glad that the safe path stayed open even when the room filled. A small hill near the shore could be seen from the hall window.
paragraphs.zh: 有聲版中，達洛替魚配上柔和聲音。海邊場景響起希多的歌。戴帽子的魚轉錯方向時，孩子們笑了。第二條小魚出現時，妮米坐直身子微笑。塞拉知道，孩子看見自己的點子成真了。塞拉希望每個人都能享受同一齣戲的兩種觀賞方式。 開燈前，達洛把腳移離燈盒。 烏瑪很高興，即使房間坐滿，安全走道仍通暢。 從廳堂窗戶可以看見岸邊一座小山。

paragraphs.en: The quiet version came next. There were no spoken lines, and the figures moved more slowly. Some visitors stayed for both shows. Others chose only one and left calmly through the side door. Sela watched them go without thinking they had enjoyed the event less. Every guest had made a choice. The evening was hot, so the friends gave guests time to get comfortable. An insect moved across the outside wall but did not disturb the show. A visitor from a nearby island chose the spoken version first. Uma put her jacket away before helping the next guests to their seats.
paragraphs.zh: 接著是安靜版。沒有旁白，角色移動得更慢。有些訪客兩場都看，另一些只選一場，便平靜地從側門離開。塞拉沒有因此認為他們比較不喜歡活動。每位訪客都做了自己的選擇。傍晚天氣很熱，因此朋友們讓客人有時間坐得舒服。 一隻昆蟲爬過外牆，沒有打擾演出。 一位來自附近島嶼的訪客先選有聲版。 烏瑪先收好外套，再帶下一批客人入座。

paragraphs.en: At the end, Sela came out from behind the cloth. She did not take all the thanks for herself. She named Daro, Uma, Hedo, Nemi, and the neighbors who had agreed to share ideas. Then she thanked the helpers who kept the hall clean and safe. People clapped in a gentle way. The town kept a small box of medicine in the staff area for emergencies. Daro used a pin to hold a paper list on the wall, far from visitors. The first row of seats was left open for people who needed a clearer view. Since the show was free, every guest received the same welcome.
paragraphs.zh: 結尾時，塞拉從白布後走出來。她沒有把全部感謝留給自己，而是說出達洛、烏瑪、希多、妮米，以及同意分享點子的鄰居們的名字。她也謝謝維持廳堂乾淨安全的幫手。人們輕輕鼓掌。鎮上在工作人員區放了一小箱應急藥品。 達洛用圖釘把紙清單固定在牆上，遠離訪客。 第一排座位保留給需要較清楚視線的人。 因為演出免費，每位客人都受到相同的歡迎。

paragraphs.en: After the last guests left, Daro held the two fish while Sela found their places in the box. The special ending had brought a smile to Nemi's face, but now even those figures needed to rest. Uma counted the chairs and looked down the open path to the door. The price of a seat had stayed zero, just as they had promised. 'We can put the cloth away tomorrow,' Daro said. Sela agreed. Tonight they only needed to leave the room ready for the people who would open it in the morning. Outside, louder music still came from the fair. She could enjoy hearing it now, knowing that the hall had offered another choice.
paragraphs.zh: 最後一批客人離開後，達洛拿著兩條魚，塞拉替它們在箱裡找位置。特別結尾讓妮米微笑，但如今連紙偶也需要休息。烏瑪數椅子，看通往門口的通暢路線。每個座位仍是零元，正如他們承諾的。「白布明天再收也可以，」達洛說。塞拉同意。今晚只需把房間留給早晨來開門的人。外面，節慶仍傳來較大聲的音樂。她現在能自在聽著，因為知道廳堂提供了另一種選擇。

questions.question: What were the two performances?
options: A spoken version and a quiet version.
A boat race and a dance.
questions.explanation: 節慶有旁白版與安靜版兩場演出。

questions.question: What did Sela do after the show?
options: She thanked and named the helpers.
questions.explanation: 她逐一感謝創作者與幕後幫手。

paragraphs.en: During the last week of the trial month, the town held a meeting about the hall’s future. Oren brought the notes from the one-month trial plan, and neighbors shared what they hoped to do next. Sela came with Daro and Uma. She was not afraid to speak, but she was careful not to speak for everyone else. The friends were able to teach new groups how to use the screen safely. Sela was no longer afraid that every change would ruin her idea. Oren said the town would allow different groups to try public events. A small cat came to the meeting with a soft doll and waited near the door.
paragraphs.zh: 試行月的最後一週，小鎮針對廳堂未來再次開會。歐倫帶來一個月試行計畫的紀錄，鄰居們也分享未來想做的活動。塞拉與達洛、烏瑪一起出席。她不怕發言，但很小心不替所有人說話。朋友們有能力教新團體安全使用布幕。 塞拉不再害怕任何改變都會毀掉她的點子。 歐倫說，鎮上會允許不同團體試辦公開活動。 一隻小貓帶著柔軟布娃娃來參加會議，在門旁等候。

paragraphs.en: One group wanted a drawing afternoon. Another wanted to teach simple songs. An older neighbor hoped for a place to play quiet games. Sela suggested that each month a different group could lead an open event. The town agreed to try this for a season, with the same rules for safety and welcome. The child found a comfortable place to stand behind the cloth. The doll made a funny round shadow beside the old paper fish. Sela made a simple guide for new groups to follow when using the lamp. When the first guests left, Sela waved goodbye and thanked them for coming.
paragraphs.zh: 一組人想辦繪畫下午，另一組想教簡單歌曲，一位年長鄰居希望有安靜玩遊戲的空間。塞拉建議每個月由不同團體帶領開放活動。鎮上同意先試行一季，沿用相同的安全與歡迎規則。孩子在白布後找到一個舒服的站位。 布娃娃在舊紙魚旁投出滑稽的圓形影子。 塞拉做了一份簡單指南，供新團體使用燈時參考。 第一批客人離開時，塞拉揮手道別，謝謝他們來。

paragraphs.en: Daro packed the fish figures into a neat box. He did not want them to stay on the stage forever. The cloth could hold a hundred other stories. Uma made a clear calendar so people could see when the room was free. Sela said they would help the next group learn the lights and the seating plan. A child showed interest in learning how to move the small figures. The hall would live a new life as a shared room for many kinds of art. Uma put the new monthly map of events beside the door. Daro helped the next group pack its paper figures after practice.
paragraphs.zh: 達洛把魚偶整齊裝箱，不希望它們永遠占著舞台。這塊布還可以承載上百個別人的故事。烏瑪做了清楚的日曆，讓人知道廳堂何時可用。塞拉說，他們願意教下一組如何使用燈和座位配置。一個孩子表示有興趣學習如何移動小角色。 廳堂將以共享空間的新身分展開新的生活，容納各種藝術。 烏瑪把新月份的活動地圖放在門旁。 下一組練習後，達洛幫忙把紙角色裝好。

paragraphs.en: At the next open day, the small cat brought the doll back and asked if the doll could have a turn behind the cloth. Sela showed how to hold it near the lamp. A new shadow appeared, different from the old fish. The child laughed, and another visitor asked if they could try too. A wooden ship appeared as a shadow in the new child's little story. A girl in a long skirt waited for her turn behind the screen. Sometimes a quiet person had the most surprising idea. Sela said thank you to Daro and Uma for staying with the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 下一次開放日，那隻小貓又帶著布娃娃來，問能否讓娃娃也在白布後出場。塞拉示範如何把娃娃靠近燈，一個和舊魚不同的影子就出現了。孩子笑起來，另一位訪客也問自己能不能試試。新孩子的小故事裡，出現了一艘木船的影子。 穿長裙的女孩在布幕後等候輪到自己。 有時最安靜的人會有最令人驚喜的點子。 塞拉謝謝達洛和烏瑪一路陪著這個計畫。

paragraphs.en: Uma checked the lamp twice before she turned it off. Daro made the room tidy, leaving a clear table for the next group. At the door, a family asked about a trip to Shell Bay on the next art day. Sela showed them the calendar instead of promising an extra show of her own. Other neighbors would have their turn to lead. On the empty program cover, she wrote one word: Together. Below it she put the names of the friends and helpers who wanted to be named. Then she closed the book. Tomorrow a different person could open the door and find enough room for a different story. Sela walked home with nothing left to prove on the little stage.
paragraphs.zh: 烏瑪檢查燈兩次，才把它關上。達洛整理房間，留出乾淨桌子給下一組。門口，一家人問下次藝術日到貝殼灣旅行的事。塞拉指給他們看日曆，沒有再承諾加演自己的戲。其他鄰居也會輪到帶領活動。她在空白節目單封面寫下一個字：一起。下面是朋友，以及願意具名的幫手姓名。然後她闔上本子。明天，不同的人可以打開門，為不同故事找到足夠空間。塞拉走回家，不必再在小舞台上證明什麼。

questions.question: What did the town decide about the hall?
options: Different groups could lead open events during a trial season.
It would be closed to everyone.
questions.explanation: 鎮上同意試行一季，每月由不同團體辦開放活動。

questions.question: What showed the hall's new future?
options: A child making a new doll shadow.
questions.explanation: 孩子帶來布娃娃創作新影子，象徵廳堂將迎接不同故事。
